1: # BK7258 OpenVela UART0 Mailbox V2完整收发移植方案
2: 
3: ## 1. 文档目标和结论
4: 
5: 本文是`BK7258_OPENVELA_AP_PORTING_PLAN.md`中UART0和Mailbox V2章节的可实施细化方案。依据当前工作区的OpenVela AP实现、`bk_avdk_smp` AP/CP源码、比赛仓CP覆盖文件、原厂网页文档和生成的内存布局，目标是在不占用CPU1物理UART1、不改变CP物理UART0下载和启动行为的前提下，实现：
6: 
7: ```text
8: AP/OpenVela输出
9:   NuttX console/syslog/NSH stdout
10:     -> AP MB_UART0 TX
11:     -> Mailbox V2 logical channel 0x19
12:     -> CP MB_UART0 RX
13:     -> CP shell TX queue
14:     -> CP UART0/GPIO11/CH340/PC
15: 
16: PC输入
17:   PC/CH340/UART0 RX/GPIO10
18:     -> CP shell UART RX owner
19:     -> 显式AP console输入模式
20:     -> CP MB_UART0 TX
21:     -> Mailbox V2 logical channel 0x49
22:     -> AP MB_UART0 RX
23:     -> NuttX serial upper-half
24:     -> /dev/console/NSH stdin
25: ```
26: 
27: 最终结论：
28: 
29: - `MB_UART0`本身是全双工、带软件RTS/CTS流控的虚拟UART，不是单向日志命令。
30: - AP发送使用logical channel `0x19`，CP发送使用logical channel `0x49`；两者都是同一个MB_UART0的本端发送编号。
31: - 每个Mailbox V2 envelope只携带16字节message的地址和长度；DATA message再携带固定128字节交换区的地址和有效长度。
32: - 当前本地AP实现只完成AP到CP的输出；收到CP DATA后固定返回成功但不复制数据。当前CP覆盖也只读取AP输出，没有PC到AP输入路径。
33: - 完整移植必须同时修改OpenVela AP和Armino CP。只补AP RX或只调用CP `bk_mb_uart_write()`都不能形成完整控制台。
34: - 正式实现保持原厂16字节message、DATA/STATE和RTS/CTS线协议兼容，但必须修复本地实现的buffer所有权、ACK队列、reset、RX校验和NuttX serial接入问题；不得照搬原厂未初始化尾字节、未校验payload指针和失败后静默丢包等缺陷。
35: 
36: ## 2. 基线、范围和非目标
37: 
38: ### 2.1 开发和交付目录
39: 
40: - OpenVela AP开发目录：`contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/`。
41: - OpenVela board配置：`contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/`。
42: - CP可复现覆盖的权威副本：`contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/`。
43: - CP实际构建树：`bk_avdk_smp/`。CP改动必须先落权威副本，再按该目录`README.md`同步到构建树并逐字节检查。
44: - `bk_idk`、`bk_solution_ai`、`vendor_beken`和网页文档仅作为参考，不是BK7258 OpenVela正式开发目录。
45: 
46: ### 2.2 本轮范围
47: 
48: - Mailbox V2 CPU1 channel 1物理收发、IRQ79、FIFO drain和错误恢复。
49: - CPU1到CPU0 logical channel复用调度，至少不破坏HW_CTRL、PWC和UART0。
50: - AP侧MB_UART0 DATA/STATE、双向ring、流控、ACK和NuttX serial lower-half。
51: - CP侧MB_UART0接收输出和UART0输入转发。
52: - CP CLI与AP NSH对唯一UART0输入的显式所有权切换。
53: - 冷启动、AP重启、CP重启、Mailbox reset和压力验收。
54: 
55: ### 2.3 非目标
56: 
57: - 不启用CPU1物理UART1，不切换GPIO0/1，不要求第二个USB-TTL。
58: - 不用`MB_CHNL_LOG`的`MB_CMD_USER_INPUT`替代逐字节TTY。该协议只能转发完整Armino CLI命令，不具备NSH readline、退格和Ctrl-C语义。
59: - 不修改bootloader下载串口协议。AP console接管只能发生在CP运行期，并且必须在AP ready以后。
60: - 不承诺在Mailbox IRQ和调度器可用前输出启动日志。panic时若中断关闭，MB_UART也不能工作；原厂文档同样明确其不是无中断polling UART。
61: - 第一版不启用MB_UART CRC8。原厂当前配置下CRC恒为0；单边启用会不兼容。保留字段并校验其为0，后续只能在AP/CP同时升级后启用。
62: 
63: ## 3. 已确认的协议事实
64: 
65: ### 3.1 CPU和logical channel编码
66: 
67: logical channel为8位：
68: 
69: ```text
70: bit[7:6] destination CPU
71: bit[5:4] source CPU
72: bit[3:0] logical channel index
73: ```
74: 
75: CPU0/CP为0，CPU1/AP为1。UART0的组内index为9，因此：
76: 
77: | 本端 | 方向 | 发送channel | 接收报文中的channel |
78: | --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
79: | AP/OpenVela | CPU1 -> CPU0 | `0x19` | `0x49` |
80: | CP/Armino | CPU0 -> CPU1 | `0x49` | `0x19` |
81: 
82: 参考：
83: 
84: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:32-44,53,77-96`
85: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:29-41,49,64-83`
86: 
87: 不得将`0x19`和`0x49`理解为两个独立UART，也不得用IPC `0x10`、PWC `0x12/0x42`或`MB_CHNL_LOG`承载UART字节流。
88: 
89: ### 3.2 Mailbox V2 envelope
90: 
91: MBOX0硬件FIFO中的两个data word是：
92: 
93: | FIFO word | 含义 |
94: | --- | --- |
95: | `data[0]` | 发送端稳定16字节message的32位地址 |
96: | `data[1]` | 固定为16 |
97: 
98: 接收端根据硬件SID确认源CPU，再复制16字节message。AP接收的message地址来自CP拥有的稳定SRAM，CP接收的地址来自AP拥有的稳定SRAM。不能让FIFO引用栈变量，也不能在对端复制前复用或改写该slot。
99: 
100: ### 3.3 16字节message header
101: 
102: word0布局固定如下：
103: 
104: ```text
105: bit[7:0]   cmd
106: bit[11:8]  state
107: bit[15:12] ctrl
108: bit[23:16] tx_seq
109: bit[31:24] logical_chnl
110: ```
111: 
112: `ctrl`定义：
113: 
114: | 位 | 名称 | 语义 |
115: | ---: | --- | --- |
116: | 0 | `CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX` | 1表示transport ACK，0表示command |
117: | 1 | `CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX` | 无ACK同步发送；正式UART普通路径不使用 |
118: | 2 | `CHNL_CTRL_RESET` | transport重同步 |
119: 
120: `state bit0`为`CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL`。ACK必须至少匹配`source/destination + logical_chnl + tx_seq + cmd`，不匹配的ACK只能计为stale/bad ACK，不能释放当前事务。
121: 
122: ### 3.4 MB_UART message布局
123: 
124: 协议运行于ARM32 little-endian。不得在OpenVela实现中继续依赖编译器bitfield，使用显式mask/shift和定宽字段。
125: 
126: DATA/STATE command为16字节：
127: 
128: | offset | 大小 | 字段 |
129: | ---: | ---: | --- |
130: | 0 | 1 | `cmd`：DATA=0，STATE=1 |
131: | 1 | 1 | state/ctrl，发送command时初始为0 |
132: | 2 | 1 | transport sequence |
133: | 3 | 1 | logical channel |
134: | 4 | 4 | DATA交换buffer地址；STATE为0 |
135: | 8 | 2 | DATA有效长度1..128；STATE为0 |
136: | 10 | 1 | bit0=`uart_rts`，其余必须0 |
137: | 11 | 1 | `crc8`，当前兼容值为0 |
138: | 12 | 4 | 保留，必须清0 |
139: 
140: ACK为同一个16字节slot的响应语义：
141: 
142: | offset | 含义 |
143: | ---: | --- |
144: | 0..3 | 原cmd、state，加ACK ctrl、sequence和channel |
145: | 4 bit0 | 接收端当前`uart_rts` |
146: | 4 bit1 | `uart_tx_fail`，本DATA整包未接收 |
147: | 4 bit7:2 | 0 |
148: | 5..15 | 0 |
149: 
150: 所有command和ACK结构在构造前必须`memset(..., 0, 16)`，避免原厂实现中offset 12..15栈残留和ACK尾部旧数据泄漏。这是AP/CP同步升级后的正式ABI要求：当前原厂CP command确实可能带非零栈残留，因此CP清零修复必须先于AP启用严格保留字段拒绝策略，不能只升级AP。
151: 
152: ### 3.5 UART0交换区和所有权
153: 
154: 项目RAM布局固定预留：
155: 
156: ```text
157: SWAP = 0x2809f800..0x2809ffff, size 0x800
158: ```
159: 
160: 来自：
161: 
162: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv:6-10`
163: - 生成的`ram_regions.h`中`CONFIG_SWAP_ADDR=0x2809f800`、`CONFIG_SWAP_SIZE=0x800`
164: 
165: 每个支持共享payload的logical channel占`0x200`字节，顺序为HW_CTRL、LOG、UART0、UART1。每个方向/CPU slot为128字节。当前CPU0/CPU1 UART0精确映射为：
166: 
167: | 地址 | owner/方向 | AP视角 |
168: | --- | --- | --- |
169: | `0x2809fc00..0x2809fc7f` | CP host_tx[CPU1] | AP RX payload，只读后复制 |
170: | `0x2809fc80..0x2809fcff` | CPU2预留 | AP不得使用 |
171: | `0x2809fd00..0x2809fd7f` | AP host_rx[CPU1] | AP TX payload，ACK前保持不变 |
172: | `0x2809fd80..0x2809fdff` | CPU2预留 | AP不得使用 |
173: 
174: OpenVela linker必须新增独立`SWAP` memory region并标记为`NOLOAD`。当前构建顺序是先构建OpenVela、后构建SMP，OpenVela不能读取尚未生成的CP `ram_regions.h`；单一来源固定为比赛仓已提交的`external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv`。增加预构建生成/校验脚本，由该CSV同时生成或核对OpenVela board header和linker fragment；最终SMP构建后再与Armino生成的`CONFIG_SWAP_ADDR/SIZE`自动比较。不能维护两套无校验硬编码。
175: 
176: 不能把SWAP并入AP heap，不能由AP启动代码清零整个SWAP，也不能在AP `.bss`另建一个“看起来等价”的交换buffer。
177: 
178: 首版在`bk7258_start.c`增加显式共享MPU region，并先读取MPU `TYPE.DREGION`确认region预算：CP普通RAM中的envelope窗口为shareable、non-cacheable、RO/XN；CP拥有的UART0 RX payload `0x2809fc00..0x2809fc7f`为RO/XN；AP拥有的UART0 TX payload `0x2809fd00..0x2809fd7f`为RW/XN。当前MPU使用`PRIVDEFENA`，未覆盖地址对privileged内核仍可访问，因此CPU2预留slot只能由MB_UART软件白名单/API禁止访问，不能声称由MPU隔离。
179: 
180: 若硬件region数不足以按128字节拆分，才允许将整个SWAP设为RW/XN，但必须记录这是硬件粒度降级并继续以软件白名单强制方向所有权，不能把CP普通RAM扩大为RW。若未来要求硬件阻止访问预留slot，必须关闭`PRIVDEFENA`并完整映射所有必要内存，这不属于本轮UART移植。
181: 
182: 若后续启用D-cache，所有ownership交接统一由共享内存API执行：发布前clean + DMB，读取前invalidate + DMB，ACK后才复用；cache line为32字节，操作必须向外对齐且不能误刷相邻owner数据。

184: ## 4. 当前实现差距
185: 
186: ### 4.1 AP侧
187: 
188: 当前`bk7258_mailbox_channel.c`具备基础`0x19/0x49`分派、AP TX ring和transport ACK匹配，但存在以下交付阻断项：
189: 
190: 1. `MB_CHNL_UART0_RX`只检查DATA/STATE后固定返回`uart_rts=0, uart_tx_fail=0`，不校验、不复制CP payload，输入被静默丢弃。
191: 2. 没有MB_UART RX ring、RTS高低水位、STATE发送和对端RTS/CTS门控。
192: 3. AP TX payload使用普通AP `.bss`中的`g_uart_xchg`，没有复用原厂SWAP地址和跨核固定所有权。
193: 4. 单个`g_ack_message`在FIFO full时可被下一条RX覆盖。
194: 5. ACK超时后清busy并原地改sequence重发同一buffer，会造成旧FIFO envelope观察到新内容、重复日志和非幂等PWC重复执行。

198: 9. logical channel和MB_UART混在一个文件，无法清晰复用和测试状态机。
199: 10. 仅`up_irq_save()`适用于当前单核AP；进入NuttX SMP后不能阻止CPU2并发。

201: 当前`bk7258_serial.c`的`receive()`固定返回-1、`rxavailable()`固定false、`rxint()`为空，因而`read()`、`poll(POLLIN)`和NSH均无输入。设备同时冒充硬件UART1并注册`/dev/ttyS1`，Kconfig/defconfig也错误命名为UART1。

260: ## 6. AP Mailbox V2 transport设计
261: 
262: ### 6.1 物理层
263: 
264: CPU1只配置自己拥有的channel 1：FIFO start=2、length=3，接收IRQ source 63映射到NuttX IRQ79。物理层初始化必须在`up_initialize()`可使用NuttX IRQ API后、board late逻辑服务前完成。
265: 
266: ISR固定执行：
267: 
268: 1. 读取并累计`wrerr/rderr/wrfull`等W1C错误状态。
269: 2. 循环读取FIFO直到empty，不能每次中断只取一个。
270: 3. 校验SID为CPU0、length为16、地址4字节对齐、`address + 16`无溢出且位于CP RAM `0x28064000..0x2809f6ff`。当前CP `mbox0_adapter.c`的envelope slot是可随链接变化的普通`.bss mailbox_buff`，并没有固定地址ABI或32字节对齐，AP不能写死更小窗口。
271: 4. 立即复制到AP-owned RX descriptor queue，随后上层处理；不能长期持有CP message指针。
272: 5. 若RX descriptor queue或ACK资源不足，停止继续drain并保留中断，不能读出后无ACK丢弃。
273: 
274: 初始化时不再盲目drain。应先安装logical callback和RX/ACK资源，再处理已有FIFO。无法识别的有效command也必须返回`COM_FAIL` ACK。
275: 
276: ### 6.2 稳定transaction slot
277: 
278: 每个CPU0物理方向同时只允许一个command in-flight，以兼容原厂physical BUSY模型。实现至少准备：
279: 
280: - 每个logical channel一个16字节pending command副本。
281: - 一个独立16字节active slot；发送后直到ACK/reset完成不可修改。
282: - 至少3个AP-owned ACK slots和一个ACK FIFO，容量不小于硬件RX FIFO深度。
283: - AP新建的active/ACK message slot按32字节对齐并位于AP RAM白名单；接收CP envelope只要求原厂ABI的4字节对齐和CP RAM范围。payload SWAP另行精确校验。
284: 
285: slot释放事件必须明确，因为硬件FIFO保存的是地址而不是16字节值：
286: 
287: - command正常收到匹配ACK后可释放。
288: - command timeout后转为quarantine；发送RESET不释放它。RESET和随后STATE使用各自独立稳定slot。只有STATE收到成功ACK，利用同一AP->CP FIFO顺序证明旧command、RESET和STATE都已被复制后，才一起释放旧command和RESET slot。STATE失败时保持quarantine，直到MBOX硬件重新初始化，不能因进入DOWN就复用。
289: - ACK slot不能以“收到对端下一条command”为释放证据，因为对端timeout后可能绕过旧ACK继续发送。只有本端随后一个同方向、需要ACK的普通事务收到成功ACK，才能证明排在它之前的本端ACK envelope已经被对端复制。
290: - ACK pool达到高水位（建议已占用2/3）时，transport必须立即在所有待发ACK之后调度一个独立稳定slot的STATE probe。probe收到成功ACK后，按本端FIFO发送顺序批量释放排在它之前的ACK slots；probe失败则进入DOWN并保持这些slot quarantine。不能依赖heartbeat或应用数据未来恰好出现。
291: - RESET和SYNC都没有自己的ACK。RESET由紧随其后的成功STATE释放；通用SYNC使用独立slot，并在下一个同方向普通事务成功完成后释放。专用slot尚未释放时再次调用同类旁路发送返回`-EBUSY`，不得有限轮转后覆盖。
292: - ACK在DOWN、ABORTING、PROBING和QUIESCING状态下仍是最高发送优先级；状态变化不能免除已经接收的对端command所需ACK。
293: 
294: CP `mbox0_adapter.c`也按相同原则分别管理command、ACK、RESET和SYNC slot，禁止现有“每次发送无条件轮转两个slot”的做法。
295: 
296: 调度优先级保持原厂“logical index越小优先级越高”：HW_CTRL、PWC优先于UART0，避免日志压力阻塞heartbeat和电源命令。ACK永远高于新command。
297: 
298: ### 6.3 ACK和超时
299: 
300: 收到ACK后完整检查：
301: 
302: ```text
303: SID == CPU0
304: ACK_BOX == 1
305: logical_channel == active.channel
306: tx_seq == active.seq
307: cmd == active.cmd
308: RESET/state/reserved组合合法
309: ```
310: 
311: 匹配成功后才释放active slot并调用logical completion。UART completion再根据`COM_FAIL`和`uart_tx_fail`决定成功或失败。
312: 
313: 超时不得直接修改active buffer并重发。第一版策略：
314: 
315: 1. 200 ms无ACK，标记当前transaction失败并保留错误快照。
316: 2. 停止所有普通新TX，向CPU0发送原厂兼容RESET abort通知；RESET使用独立稳定slot。
317: 3. RESET是`ACK_BOX|RESET`单向通知，CP空闲时会忽略，不返回RESET ACK。AP发送成功后进入PROBING，并用独立slot发送后续MB_UART STATE；不能等待不存在的RESET ACK，也不能复用被abort事务的slot。
318: 4. abort发出或收到peer reset后，所有pending非幂等PWC请求以`-ECONNRESET`完成，不自动重放。
319: 5. UART chunk可保留在本地TX ring，重新交换STATE后最多重发一次；日志允许重复风险时也必须通过计数可见。建议默认不自动重发已经可能被对端消费但ACK丢失的chunk，而是丢弃该chunk并累计`tx_unknown`，避免终端出现重复字符。
320: 6. RESET envelope发送失败或后续STATE仍无ACK则link进入DOWN，heartbeat/ready逻辑可检测并执行既定降级或复位策略。
321: 
322: 8位sequence在每次新transaction递增，0可自然出现；本地abort后建立新的软件epoch。不能仅靠wire sequence解决跨reset的极晚ACK。链路状态统一为`DOWN/ABORTING/PROBING/READY/QUIESCING`：ABORTING不发新的普通command，PROBING只发STATE普通command，但所有状态始终优先发送已欠的ACK。
323: 
324: 只有STATE ACK同时满足channel/sequence/cmd匹配、`COM_FAIL==0`、`uart_tx_fail==0`、保留字段合法并成功取得peer RTS时，才能从PROBING进入READY。匹配但带`COM_FAIL`的ACK表示CP尚未open MB_UART0，应在有界退避后继续探测，达到总超时后进入DOWN。
325: 
326: ### 6.4 reset方向
327: 
328: AP transport初始化完成后主动向CP发送一次原厂RESET abort通知，作用是让CP结束可能指向上一个AP boot的in-flight transaction。它不是双向握手：AP不等待响应，而是随后发送STATE探测。收到CP RESET时：
329: 
330: - 对当前active事务生成`-ECONNRESET` completion，但其slot转入quarantine而不复用。反方向收到peer RESET不能证明本端目标FIFO中的旧envelope已经被复制。
331: - 终止本端active/pending outgoing事务并清理其physical busy和peer RTS已知状态；不得清理已经接收且尚未发送的ACK queue。
332: - 保留尚未提交的本地UART TX ring，丢弃不完整AP RX chunk。
333: - 不返回RESET ACK；按原厂语义完成本端abort，再由MB_UART STATE/ACK恢复流控。
334: 
335: CP侧原厂channel层已有处理AP reset并将旧事务以`COM_FAIL`完成的基础逻辑；CP空闲时会直接忽略RESET。上板前需验证当前CP分支未被其他补丁破坏。
336: 
337: quarantine slot只能由后续同方向STATE成功ACK释放，或由明确清空AP->CP目标channel/FIFO的CP侧重初始化、全系统复位释放。AP只重初始化自己的channel 1、IRQ或RX FIFO不能证明CPU0目标FIFO中的旧地址已消失，不得作为释放条件。
338: 
339: ## 7. AP MB_UART0设计
340: 
341: ### 7.1 控制块
342: 
343: AP MB_UART0至少维护：
344: 
345: - `tx_ring`：建议4096或8192字节，用于console/syslog burst，单producer假设不可成立，写入需NuttX spinlock保护。
346: - `rx_ring`：257字节，实际容量256，与原厂语义一致。
347: - 固定AP TX SWAP地址`0x2809fd00`，固定AP RX SWAP地址`0x2809fc00`。
348: - `tx_inflight_len`、`tx_command`、`tx_busy`和`state_pending`。
349: - `local_rts`：AP RX流控；0允许CP发送，1暂停。
350: - `peer_rts`：来自CP command/ACK；0允许AP发送，1暂停。
351: - `rx_irq_enabled`：NuttX serial upper-half当前是否允许接收。
352: - link状态：DOWN/ABORTING/PROBING/READY/QUIESCING。
353: - 分项统计：write/drop、DATA/STATE、overflow、bad pointer/length/CRC、remote fail、ACK timeout、reset、high watermark持续时间。
354: 
355: ### 7.2 AP发送
356: 
357: `write()`只把实际可容纳的字节数写入TX ring并返回该字节数，不返回“部分写入后-ENOSPC”这种不可恢复语义。NuttX serial `send()`每次一个字符，syslog bulk write则循环分片并准确报告短写。
358: 
359: 发送条件：link READY、无MB_UART transaction in-flight、`peer_rts==0`、TX ring非空。每次最多取128字节复制到`0x2809fd00`，构造DATA：
360: 
361: ```text
362: cmd_buff     = 0x2809fd00
363: cmd_data_len = min(tx_count, 128)
364: uart_rts     = local_rts
365: crc8         = 0
366: reserved     = 0
367: ```
368: 
369: 与当前本地代码不同，TX ring读指针在成功ACK后才推进。收到`COM_FAIL`或`uart_tx_fail`时不推进；先记录失败并按reset策略处理，避免原厂“提交logical write即消费，ACK失败静默丢失”的缺陷。
370: 
371: 若没有数据但`local_rts`发生变化，发送STATE。DATA ACK本身已携带最新RTS，因此在DATA处理中可合并待发STATE，但不能丢掉最终状态变化。
372: 
373: ### 7.3 AP接收
374: 
375: 收到channel `0x49` command后先验证header，再处理：
376: 
377: DATA必须同时满足：
378: 
379: - `cmd_buff == 0x2809fc00`，不接受“位于SWAP任意位置”或普通CP RAM中的任意指针。
380: - `1 <= cmd_data_len <= 128`，地址加法无溢出。
381: - `crc8 == 0`且保留位为0。
382: - 当前link允许接收。
383: 
384: 接收前执行共享内存acquire/cache invalidate。只有RX ring剩余空间大于等于整包长度时才整包复制；否则整包不复制，设置sticky overflow并在ACK中置`uart_tx_fail=1`。绝不部分接收后报告失败，否则发送端无法确定消费边界。
385: 
386: 无论DATA还是STATE，都更新`peer_rts=command.uart_rts`。响应ACK包含最新`local_rts`。成功DATA复制后触发NuttX RX处理；ISR内不运行NSH、不格式化日志。
387: 
388: ### 7.4 RTS/CTS水位
389: 
390: 保持原厂兼容阈值：
391: 
392: - RX ring总数组257字节、容量256。
393: - 剩余空间`<=128`时设置`local_rts=1`，确保已经在途的一个最大128字节chunk仍有明确处理结果。
394: - 应用读取后，occupancy低于102字节时设置`local_rts=0`并发送STATE，提供滞回避免状态抖动。
395: - `peer_rts=1`时AP禁止新DATA，但仍允许必要的ACK、RESET和本端STATE。
396: 
397: 由于NuttX还有一层`uart_dev_s.recv` ring，MB_UART RX ring的RTS必须根据“MB_UART ring可用空间”管理；`uart_recvchars()`应及时搬运到NuttX ring。新的`BK7258_MB_UART0_CONSOLE` Kconfig必须`select OTHER_UART_SERIALDRIVER`、`select OTHER_SERIAL_CONSOLE`和`select SERIAL_IFLOWCONTROL`，不能只在defconfig手写隐藏symbol；`OTHER_SERIAL_CONSOLE`再通过NuttX console choice选择`SERIAL_CONSOLE`。
398: 
399: 第一版同时启用`SERIAL_IFLOWCONTROL_WATERMARKS`，upper/lower watermark固定为75%/25%。NuttX upper-half到达75%时停止继续搬运并保持/拉高MB_UART RTS；低于25%后重新调用搬运并释放RTS。若不启watermark选项，NuttX只会在full/empty回调，不能声称具备本文的高低水位行为。
400: 
401: ### 7.5 NuttX serial接入
402: 
403: 正式设备不再冒充物理UART1：
404: 
405: - 注册`/dev/console`和`/dev/ttyMB0`到同一个Mailbox UART device。
406: - 删除`CONFIG_UART1_SERIALDRIVER`、`CONFIG_UART1_SERIAL_CONSOLE`和`BK7258_AP_UART1`误导配置。
407: - 新增板级`BK7258_MB_UART0_CONSOLE`选择，并让NuttX console宏映射到该虚拟设备。
408: - 不执行任何UART1 clock、pinmux或GPIO0/1配置。
409: 
410: `uart_ops_s`实现：
411: 
412: | op | 行为 |
413: | --- | --- |
414: | `setup/attach` | 确认MB_UART已注册callback，不能重复初始化physical mailbox |
415: | `shutdown/detach` | 普通console关闭不销毁全局heartbeat共用transport |
416: | `receive` | 从MB_UART RX ring弹出1字节，status返回overflow/parity sticky快照 |
417: | `rxavailable` | 查询MB_UART RX ring非空 |
418: | `rxint` | 保存enable；enable时投递RX worker或调用受控`uart_recvchars()` |
419: | `send` | 写一个字节到MB_UART TX ring；只在`txready`为true时由upper-half调用 |
420: | `txint` | enable时调用`uart_xmitchars()`，ACK/CTS恢复后再次kick |
421: | `txready` | link ready、TX ring有空间；不要求物理channel当前idle |
422: | `txempty` | NuttX xmit ring、MB_UART TX ring和active DATA都为空 |
423: | `rxflowcontrol` | upper-half高水位时拉高local RTS，恢复时拉低并kick RX |
424: 
425: Mailbox ISR只将DATA复制到MB_UART RX ring并post一个高优先级worker/semaphore。worker调用`uart_recvchars()`，避免在硬件Mailbox ISR里进入完整TTY路径。TX ACK或peer RTS从1变0时，同样由worker调用`uart_xmitchars()`。
426: 
427: ### 7.6 syslog和early putc
428: 
429: - transport ready前允许写入一个小型有界early TX ring；满后丢弃并计数，不阻塞启动。
430: - transport ready后由MB_UART worker排空early数据。
431: - bulk syslog按`size_t`循环，每次传入不超过`UINT16_MAX`，返回实际接受字节数；不能无条件返回原长度。
432: - `sc_force`和`arm_lowputc`仍只能best-effort，不宣称IRQ关闭时可靠。可提供有界flush，例如等待不超过20 ms；禁止永久等待ACK。
433: - 避免console和独立syslog backend重复输出同一条日志。最终配置只能有一个主syslog路径。
434: 
435: ## 8. CP UART0双向桥设计
436: 
437: ### 8.1 唯一MB_UART0 owner
438: 
439: CP只调用一次`bk_mb_uart_dev_init(MB_UART0)`。现有`ap_uart0_log_init()`扩展为统一bridge：
440: 
441: - 注册MB_UART RX callback，唤醒AP输出worker。
442: - 注册MB_UART TX callback，唤醒PC输入发送worker。
443: - 使用有界CP->AP TX ring，建议512或1024字节。
444: - worker根据`bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`处理部分写入，调用`bk_mb_uart_write()`，直到队列为空或peer RTS暂停。
445: - 暴露drop、partial write、MB_UART status、mode switch和last error统计。
446: 
447: 不得为RX和TX分别初始化两次MB_UART0，也不得让日志服务和console服务分别open channel。
448: 
449: ### 8.2 AP输出模式
450: 
451: 提供两个输出策略，但共享同一个MB_UART RX：
452: 
453: 1. `LOG`模式：保持当前按行添加`ap0: `、50 ms半行flush和有限重试，适合AP后台日志。
454: 2. `RAW_CONSOLE`模式：不添加前缀、不等待换行，收到后立即通过CP shell TX queue输出，保证`nsh>`、echo、退格和ANSI字节透明。
455: 
456: 进入AP交互console时切为RAW；退出后恢复LOG。模式切换前先flush旧的半行缓存，防止旧日志与prompt拼接。CP自身异步日志仍可能插入AP终端，第一版应在RAW模式下抑制非关键CP日志或明确串行化，至少不能从两个线程直接写物理UART0。
457: 
458: ### 8.3 UART0输入所有权
459: 
460: CP shell已拥有物理UART0 RX ISR和buffer，因此路由点放在`shell_task.c`读取UART字节之后、执行`handle_shell_input()`之前。状态固定为：
461: 
462: ```text
463: CP_CLI       所有输入由CP CLI处理
464: AP_CONSOLE   原始输入转发给MB_UART0，CP CLI不再解析
465: ```
466: 
467: 上电默认`CP_CLI`。只有满足以下条件才允许进入`AP_CONSOLE`：
468: 
469: - AP已发送Mailbox RESET abort通知并完成STATE/ACK链路探测。
470: - AP已发送IPC power-up和PWC boot ready。
471: - CP bridge确认MB_UART0可写。
472: 
473: CP CLI新增明确命令，例如`ap_console open`。命令handler只设置`SWITCH_TO_AP_PENDING`，不能立即修改owner：先等待当前命令响应和CP TX queue flush，抑制尾随`cp>`，原子清理`cmd_line_buf`、BK_REG/AT/escape解析状态并通过`SHELL_IO_CTRL_RX_RESET`清物理UART RX残留，之后才进入AP_CONSOLE并打印一次切换提示。
474: 
475: AP_CONSOLE保留一个本地退出转义，建议使用行首`Ctrl-]`后跟`.`；解析器只在行首识别完整转义，其他字节原样转发。退出时进入`SWITCH_TO_CP_PENDING`，丢弃未完成转义、停止接收新AP输入、清理或明确丢弃尚未发送的bridge TX，flush AP RAW输出后再恢复CP parser和prompt。退出转义由CP消费，不发送给NSH。
476: 
477: 禁止把同一字节同时广播给CP CLI和AP NSH，否则两个shell会同时echo/执行。下载工具、ATE和bootloader阶段不进入该状态机，维持原UART0 owner。
478: 
479: ### 8.4 PC输入发送
480: 
481: 在AP_CONSOLE状态，CP shell现有UART RX路径读取到原始字节后：
482: 
483: 1. 先运行最小退出转义状态机。
484: 2. 非转义字节写入CP->AP bridge ring。
485: 3. bridge worker根据MB_UART write-ready发送；不得在UART ISR中调用可能触发Mailbox发送和复杂锁的接口。
486: 4. ring满时优先通过MB_UART RTS自然回压；物理UART0无硬件流控，仍可能在高速粘贴时丢字，必须计数并在退出RAW后报告。
487: 5. 可选的软件输入限速按115200估算，但不得sleep在UART ISR；只能由worker分批发送。
488: 
489: AP link down/reset时CP自动退出AP_CONSOLE，清理未发送输入并恢复CP_CLI，避免用户被锁死在无响应终端。为使该行为可实现，CP `mailbox_channel.c`必须新增peer RESET/physical timeout通知，IPC heartbeat/PWC recovery也要向bridge发布AP_DOWN事件；不能从`bk_mb_uart_get_status()`推断link状态。bridge通过统一event callback处理`AP_READY/AP_DOWN/PEER_RESET`，并在事件中只唤醒worker，不直接操作shell队列。
490: 
491: ### 8.5 CP原厂驱动最小加固
492: 
493: 在不改变线协议的前提下同步修复：
494: 
495: - `mb_uart_init()`第二个NULL检查应为`rx_xchg_buff`。
496: - DATA RX校验`cmd_buff`必须等于本端预期`rx_xchg_buff`，长度1..128。
497: - 所有command/response先清零保留字段。
498: - bridge必须正确处理`bk_mb_uart_write()`部分写和`bk_mb_uart_get_status()`。
499: - `mailbox_channel.c`向bridge暴露peer reset/timeout通知；收到AP reset时即使CP physical TX为空也必须发布事件，而不是只记fault后静默返回。
500: 
501: 原厂驱动在logical write成功时提前推进TX ring，远端`uart_tx_fail`时不会回滚。若不重写CP mb_uart状态机，CP输入可靠性仍低于AP改进实现。正式交付建议把CP TX也改为“ACK成功后推进ring”，但这会扩大原厂代码改动。实施可分两步：先完成兼容双向链路并测出失败路径，再将该加固作为进入压力验收前的必做项，而不是长期保留静默丢输入行为。
502: 
503: ## 9. 启动、ready和恢复时序
504: 
505: ### 9.1 CP时序
506: 
507: ```text
508: CP bootloader/download UART0保持原行为
509:   -> CP UART0 115200 8N1和shell初始化
510:   -> Mailbox V2 physical/channel初始化
511:   -> MB_UART0唯一bridge init，注册RX/TX callback
512:   -> 默认CP_CLI模式
513:   -> 启动AP
514:   -> 等待AP IPC power-up
515:   -> 等待AP PWC boot ready
516:   -> 允许用户执行ap_console open
517: ```
518: 
519: ### 9.2 AP时序
520: 
521: ```text
522: CPU1 reset
523:   -> MPU/vector/基础NuttX启动
524:   -> 注册有界early syslog，不访问UART1
525:   -> up_initialize调用arm_serialinit
526:   -> arm_serialinit在uart_register前初始化MBOX0 IRQ79和RX资源
527:   -> 初始化logical transport、ACK pool和MB_UART0 rings/SWAP/callback
528:   -> 创建Mailbox/UART RX/TX worker；允许其在调度器运行后启动
529:   -> 发送单向RESET abort通知，不等待RESET ACK
530:   -> 异步发送STATE(local_rts=0)，arm_serialinit不阻塞等待
531:   -> 注册/dev/console和/dev/ttyMB0
532:   -> board late在worker已运行后有界等待STATE transport ACK
533:   -> 发送IPC power-up并确认transport ACK
534:   -> 启动heartbeat和PWC worker
535:   -> 发送PWC boot ready
536:   -> 启动NSH
537: ```
538: 
539: `arm_serialinit()`运行在公共`up_initialize()`中，OS/driver服务可用，但不得依赖用户初始化线程已经运行，因此这里只安装全部资源并异步kick。STATE ACK的有界等待放到board late，此时worker和系统tick已明确运行。
540: 
541: ready门禁新增：MB_UART RX已能整包复制并调用NuttX worker，TX/STATE完成至少一次探测。日志输出失败不能无限阻塞heartbeat；有界失败后记录link状态，并按产品策略决定继续无console运行还是拒绝ready。比赛调试固件建议MB_UART失败时拒绝ready，避免出现“系统似乎启动但唯一console不可用”。
542: 
543: ### 9.3 suspend/resume和重启
544: 
545: 首版若未完整实现Mailbox PM，必须对相关deep sleep投票禁止进入，不能让CP关闭共享资源后AP仍认为link READY。
546: 
547: 实现PM后流程：
548: 
549: - suspend：停止新DATA，等待active有界完成，拉高RTS，发送STATE，保存统计并关闭IRQ route。
550: - resume：重配CPU1 FIFO/IRQ、清W1C错误、发送单向RESET abort通知、用STATE/ACK探测，再恢复DATA。
551: - AP重启：AP主动发送RESET abort通知；CP transport发布PEER_RESET/AP_DOWN事件，bridge将旧AP TX以失败完成并自动退出AP_CONSOLE。
552: - CP重启：AP ACK timeout进入ABORTING/DOWN，不继续写旧payload；CP恢复后重新执行RESET abort和STATE/ACK探测。

591: ## 11. 分阶段实施
592: 
593: ### 阶段A：协议和内存固化
594: 
595: 1. 在AP代码中定义显式wire结构、mask和static assert。
596: 2. 先在CP `mb_uart_driver.c`完成command/ACK全量清零、payload指针/长度校验和NULL检查；AP严格检查保留字段以此为前置条件。
597: 3. linker加入SWAP，不清零、不进heap；构建map确认`0x2809f800..0x2809ffff`唯一。
598: 4. 写主机侧单元测试验证channel编码、header pack/unpack、地址溢出和精确payload白名单。
599: 
600: 出口：离线测试能精确生成与原厂一致的16字节DATA/STATE/ACK。
601: 
602: ### 阶段B：transport可靠化
603: 
604: 1. 修复MBOX0初始化盲目drain和错误状态。
605: 2. AP实现active command、ACK稳定slot/queue、完整ACK关联和单向reset abort；CP adapter同步改为command/ACK专用稳定slot。
606: 3. 先用HW_CTRL/PWC回归，不接console大流量。
607: 
608: 出口：power-up、heartbeat和PWC ready都收到ACK；注入FIFO full/stale ACK不会永久busy。
609: 
610: ### 阶段C：AP MB_UART全双工
611: 
612: 1. 加入固定SWAP TX/RX、DATA/STATE和RTS/CTS。
613: 2. 完成NuttX serial RX和`uart_recvchars()` worker。
614: 3. 设备改名`ttyMB0`并移除UART1配置。
615: 
616: 出口：用CP测试任务调用`bk_mb_uart_write(MB_UART0, "help\n", 5)`可驱动NSH，AP输出可返回CP。
617: 
618: ### 阶段D：CP UART0桥
619: 
620: 1. 扩展唯一MB_UART0 bridge和RAW/LOG输出。
621: 2. 在CP shell现有输入owner中加入模式切换，不注册第二个UART ISR。
622: 3. 加入延迟生效的owner切换、退出转义、transport/heartbeat事件驱动的link-down自动回退和统计命令。
623: 
624: 出口：单根Type-C上可从CP CLI进入AP NSH、交互、退出并恢复CP CLI。
625: 
626: ### 阶段E：恢复和压力
627: 
628: 1. AP/CP reset、ACK timeout、FIFO full、RX overflow、RTS持续和高速粘贴故障注入。
629: 2. heartbeat/PWC/日志/输入并发。
630: 3. PM未完成则验证sleep vote确实阻止破坏link；完成后验证suspend/resume重握手。
631: 
632: 出口：满足第12节全部验收标准后，才删除旧output-only兼容代码和UART1命名。
633: 
634: ## 12. 测试和验收矩阵
635: 
636: ### 12.1 构建和静态检查
637: 
638: - OpenVela AP `-Werror`构建通过；最终SMP `all-app.bin`完整构建通过。
639: - map中SWAP地址、大小、NOLOAD和AP heap边界正确；AP TX/RX指针分别固定为`0x2809fd00/0x2809fc00`。
640: - GPIO0/1没有UART1 pinmux，二进制无物理UART1 console初始化。
641: - CP覆盖副本与`bk_avdk_smp`目标文件`cmp -s`一致。
642: - 静态扫描不存在ISR内sleep、无界semaphore wait、printf或直接阻塞UART0输出。
643: 
644: ### 12.2 功能
645: 
646: | 用例 | 预期 |
647: | --- | --- |
648: | CP冷启动 | CP log和CP prompt正常，默认不劫持UART0输入 |
649: | AP启动 | 出现带`ap0:`的OpenVela日志，heartbeat无超时 |
650: | `ap_console open` | 切入RAW，出现`nsh>`且prompt无50 ms按行前缀改写 |
651: | NSH输入 | 字母、回车、退格、方向键、Ctrl-C均按TTY语义工作 |
652: | 退出转义 | 不传给AP，恢复CP prompt和LOG模式 |
653: | AP长输出 | 大于128字节正确分片、顺序一致、无覆盖 |
654: | PC高速粘贴 | RTS发生且系统不死锁；超出物理能力时drop计数可见 |
655: | `poll/read` | `/dev/console`和`/dev/ttyMB0`的POLLIN、blocking/nonblocking语义正确 |
656: 
657: ### 12.3 故障和并发
658: 
659: - 注入非法envelope地址、长度、SID、channel、payload地址、129字节长度和非零保留位，均拒绝且计数；有效command收到`COM_FAIL` ACK，不拖死CP physical channel。
660: - ACK FIFO满时不覆盖旧ACK；停止drain或受控恢复。
661: - 丢失DATA ACK后不原地改写in-flight slot，不出现无限重复字符。
662: - stale/wrong cmd/wrong sequence ACK不能释放当前事务。
663: - RX ring不足时整包拒绝，`uart_tx_fail=1`，不部分注入NSH。
664: - AP重启期间CP自动退出AP_CONSOLE；重启后旧输入和旧输出不重放。
665: - CP重启后AP进入DOWN并重新执行RESET abort和STATE/ACK探测，无永久`peer_rts=1`。
666: - 连续10 MiB AP输出、1 MiB双向随机字节和1小时交互期间，heartbeat、PWC和CP UART0不失效。
667: - UART压力下HW_CTRL/PWC优先于UART0，ready和heartbeat延迟有上界。
668: 
669: ### 12.4 最低可观察结果
670: 
671: ```text
672: CP boot...
673: ap0: OpenVela mailbox uart ready
674: cp> ap_console open
675: nsh> uname -a
676: ...
677: nsh>                         # 行首 Ctrl-] .
678: AP console closed
679: cp>
680: ```
681: 
682: 统计命令至少输出：link/mode、peer/local RTS、TX/RX ring occupancy、active channel/seq/cmd、DATA/STATE计数、drop、overflow、remote fail、bad envelope/payload/ACK、timeout和reset次数。
683: 
684: ## 13. 风险和明确决策
685: 
686: 1. **唯一物理UART复用风险**：UART0同时服务下载、CP shell、CP log和AP console。通过运行期显式owner切换解决，不在bootloader阶段透明桥接。
687: 2. **原厂协议无端到端可靠序号**：transport sequence只关联单次message，ACK丢失后无法判断对端是否已消费。正式策略优先避免重复输入，记录`tx_unknown`并reset，而不是盲目重发。
688: 3. **物理UART无硬件流控**：Mailbox RTS只能限制CP到AP交换，不能让CH340停止已经到达CP UART FIFO的数据。高速粘贴仍需有界CP ring和可见drop。
689: 4. **panic日志限制**：MB_UART依赖中断，不能冒充真正polling UART。验收只要求正常调度和可屏蔽短临界区下工作，不承诺hard-fault关中断后的完整日志。
690: 5. **SMP并发**：当前AP为单核时可用local IRQ lock；正式启用CPU2前，transport和ring必须切换为NuttX SMP-safe spinlock并明确CPU1 owner或跨核代理。
691: 6. **cache**：首版SWAP non-cacheable。任何启cache改动必须两端同时验证，不能只加一个DMB就宣称安全。
692: 7. **CP改动维护成本**：完整输入owner必须修改shell路径，而不是只改`driver.c`。这些文件必须纳入external覆盖和构建说明，否则下一次清理构建会丢失功能。

35:                 BK7258_MB_HEADER_SEQ_MASK |
36:                 BK7258_MB_HEADER_CHAN_MASK) == UINT32_MAX,
37:                "mailbox header masks must cover exactly 32 bits");

53: #define BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_RX     0x49u

66: #define BK7258_SWAP_SIZE            0x00000800u

99:                "mailbox length ABI offset");
100: _Static_assert(offsetof(struct bk7258_mb_wire_message, flags) == 10,
101:                "mailbox flags ABI offset");
102: _Static_assert(offsetof(struct bk7258_mb_wire_message, crc8) == 11,
103:                "mailbox CRC ABI offset");
104: _Static_assert(offsetof(struct bk7258_mb_wire_message, reserved) == 12,
105:                "mailbox reserved ABI offset");

107: static inline uint8_t
108: bk7258_mb_header_cmd(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
109: {
110:   return (message->header & BK7258_MB_HEADER_CMD_MASK) >>
111:          BK7258_MB_HEADER_CMD_SHIFT;
112: }
113: 
114: static inline uint8_t
115: bk7258_mb_header_state(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
116: {
117:   return (message->header & BK7258_MB_HEADER_STATE_MASK) >>
118:          BK7258_MB_HEADER_STATE_SHIFT;
119: }
120: 
121: static inline uint8_t
122: bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
123: {
124:   return (message->header & BK7258_MB_HEADER_CTRL_MASK) >>
125:          BK7258_MB_HEADER_CTRL_SHIFT;
126: }
127: 
128: static inline uint8_t
129: bk7258_mb_header_seq(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
130: {
131:   return (message->header & BK7258_MB_HEADER_SEQ_MASK) >>
132:          BK7258_MB_HEADER_SEQ_SHIFT;
133: }
134: 
135: static inline uint8_t
136: bk7258_mb_header_channel(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
137: {
138:   return (message->header & BK7258_MB_HEADER_CHAN_MASK) >>
139:          BK7258_MB_HEADER_CHAN_SHIFT;
140: }

142: static inline uint32_t bk7258_mb_make_header(uint8_t command, uint8_t state,
143:                                              uint8_t control, uint8_t sequence,
144:                                              uint8_t channel)
145: {
146:   return ((uint32_t)command << BK7258_MB_HEADER_CMD_SHIFT) |
147:          ((uint32_t)(state & 0x0fu) << BK7258_MB_HEADER_STATE_SHIFT) |
148:          ((uint32_t)(control & 0x0fu) << BK7258_MB_HEADER_CTRL_SHIFT) |
149:          ((uint32_t)sequence << BK7258_MB_HEADER_SEQ_SHIFT) |
150:          ((uint32_t)channel << BK7258_MB_HEADER_CHAN_SHIFT);
151: }

69: static void mbox_clear_errors(void)
70: {
71:   uint32_t config = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_CFG);
72:   uint32_t errors = config & MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
73: 
74:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
75:     {
76:       g_stats.write_error++;
77:     }
78: 
79:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
80:     {
81:       g_stats.read_error++;
82:     }
83: 
84:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
85:     {
86:       g_stats.write_full++;

101:       return false;
102:     }
103: 
104:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
105:     {
106:       g_stats.bad_length++;
107:       return false;
108:     }

110:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
111:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)

129:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
130:    * receive FIFO status register.

134:            destination == 1 ? MBOX_CH1_STATUS : MBOX_CH2_STATUS;
135:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
136:     {

161: static bool mbox_priority_message(

166:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;

169: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
170: {
171:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
172:   unsigned int i;
173: 
174:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
175:     {
176:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
177: 
178:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
179:         {

181:         }
182: 
183:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
184:         {
185:           oldest = desc;
186:         }

192: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
193: {
194:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
195:   int ret;
196: 
197:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
198:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
199:    */
200: 
201:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
202:     {
203:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
204:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
205:         {
206:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
207:           break;
208:         }
209: 
210:       desc->used = false;
211:     }
212: 
213:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
214:     {
215:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
216:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
217:         {
218:           break;
219:         }
220: 
221:       desc->used = false;
222:     }
223: }

225: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
226: {
227:   (void)irq;
228:   (void)context;
229:   (void)arg;
230: 
231:   mbox_clear_errors();
232: 
233:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
234:     {
235:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
236:       uint32_t address;
237:       uint32_t length;
238:       uint8_t source;
239: 
240:       mbox_process_desc();
241:       desc = mbox_alloc_desc();
242:       if (desc == NULL)
243:         {
244:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
245:           break;
246:         }
247: 
248:       source = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_SID) & 0x0fu;
249:       address = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA0);
250:       length = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA1);
251:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
252:         {
253:           continue;
254:         }
255: 
256:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
257:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
258:              sizeof(desc->message));
259:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
260:       desc->used = true;
261:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
262:       mbox_process_desc();
263:     }
264: 
265:   mbox_process_desc();
266: 
267:   return OK;
268: }

295:       return OK;
296:     }
297: 
298:   memset(g_rx_desc, 0, sizeof(g_rx_desc));
299:   g_rx_order = 0;

302:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
303:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
304:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
305:    */
306: 
307:   putreg32(2u | MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
308:            MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN, MBOX_CH1_CFG);
309:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
310:   modifyreg32(MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
311:   mbox_clear_errors();
312: 
313:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
314:   if (ret < 0)
315:     {
316:       return ret;
317:     }
318: 
319:   g_mbox_ready = true;
320:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
321:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
322:   return OK;
323: }

436:         {
437:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||
438:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
439:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
440:             {
441:               continue;
442:             }
443: 
444:           active = &epoch->probe;
445:           if (active->quarantine && !epoch->replay)
446:             {
447:               return -ENOLINK;
448:             }
449:         }
450:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
451:         {
452:           active = &g_active;
453:           if (active->quarantine)
454:             {
455:               return -ENOLINK;
456:             }
457:         }
458:       else
459:         {
460:           return OK;
461:         }
462: 
463:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
464:         {
465:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
466:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
467:                  sizeof(active->message));
468:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
469:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
470:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
471:             g_channel_ids[i]);
472:         }
473: 
474:       active->callback = channel->callback;
475:       active->arg = channel->arg;
476:       active->channel_index = i;
477:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
478:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
479:       if (ret < 0)
480:         {
481:           return ret;
482:         }
483: 
484:       active->busy = true;
485:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
486:         {
487:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
488:             {
489:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
490:             }
491: 
492:           g_probe_attempts++;
493:           g_stats.probes++;
494:         }
495: 
496:       return OK;
497:     }
498: 
499:   return OK;
500: }
501: 
502: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
503:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
504: {
505:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
506: 
507:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
508:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
509:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
510:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
511:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
512:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
513:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
514: }
515: 
516: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
517: {
518:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
519:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
520:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
521: }
522: 
523: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
524: {
525:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
526:   struct active_transaction *active;
527:   bool replay;
528:   int result;
529: 
530:   active = busy_probe();
531:   if (active == NULL)
532:     {
533:       active = &g_active;
534:     }
535: 
536:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
537:     {
538:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
539:       return;
540:     }
541: 
542:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
543:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
544:     {
545:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
546: 
547:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
548:       return;
549:     }
550: 
551:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
552:     {
553:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
554:       return;
555:     }
556: 
557:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
558:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
559: 
560:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
561:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
562:     {
563:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
564:     }
565: 
566:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
567:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
568:   if (replay)
569:     {
570:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
571:       unsigned int i;
572: 
573:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
574:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
575:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
576:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
577:        */
578: 
579:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
580:       g_active.quarantine = false;
581:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
582:         {
583:           if (i != replay_index)
584:             {
585:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
586:             }
587:         }
588: 
589:       select_recovery_epoch();
590:       (void)dispatch_locked();
591:       return;
592:     }
593: 
594:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
595: 
596:   if (g_probe_requested && g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
597:     {
598:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
599:     }
600: 
601:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
602:     {
603:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
604:         {
605:           release_recovery_slots();
606:           g_recovery_index = 0;
607:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
608:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
609:         }
610:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
611:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
612:         {
613:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
614:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
615:            */
616:         }
617:       else
618:         {
619:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
620:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
621:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
622:         }
623:     }
624: 
625:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
626:            result < 0)
627:     {
628:       begin_abort(result);
629:     }
630: 
631:   (void)dispatch_locked();
632: }
633: 
634: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
635: {
636:   struct ack_slot *slot;
637:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
638:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
639:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
640:   uint8_t state = 0;
641:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
642: 
643:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
644:     {
645:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
646:       if (slot == NULL)
647:         {
648:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
649:           return -EAGAIN;
650:         }
651:     }
652:   else
653:     {
654:       slot = NULL;
655:     }
656: 
657:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
658:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
659:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
660:     {
661:       g_stats.bad_header++;
662:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
663:     }
664:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_RX && g_uart_rx != NULL)
665:     {
666:       ret = g_uart_rx(message, &ack_flags, g_uart_rx_arg);
667:       if (ret < 0)
668:         {
669:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
670:         }
671:     }
672:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
673:     {
674:       g_pwc_rx(message);
675:       ret = OK;
676:     }
677:   else
678:     {
679:       g_stats.unsupported++;
680:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
681:     }
682: 
683:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
684:     {
685:       return OK;
686:     }
687: 
688:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
689:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
690:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
691:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
692:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
693: 
694:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
695:     {
696:       g_probe_requested = true;
697:     }
698: 
699:   (void)dispatch_locked();
700:   return OK;
701: }
702: 
703: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
704: {
705:   irqstate_t flags;
706:   uint8_t control;
707: 
708:   flags = up_irq_save();
709:   g_stats.rx++;
710:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
711: 
712:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
713:     {
714:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
715:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
716:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
717:         {
718:           g_stats.bad_header++;
719:         }
720:       else
721:         {
722:           g_stats.resets++;
723:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
724:         }
725:     }
726:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
727:     {
728:       handle_ack(message);
729:     }
730:   else
731:     {
732:       int ret = handle_command(message);
733: 
734:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
735:         {
736:           up_irq_restore(flags);
737:           return ret;
738:         }
739:     }
740: 
741:   up_irq_restore(flags);
742:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
743:   return OK;
744: }

746: static int mailbox_diag_worker(int argc, char **argv)
747: {
748:   enum bk7258_mb_link_state reported = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
749: 
750:   (void)argc;
751:   (void)argv;
752:   for (;;)
753:     {
754:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_diag_sem);
755:       irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
756:       enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_diag_state;
757:       bk7258_mb_link_callback_t callback = g_link_callback;
758:       void *callback_arg = g_link_arg;
759:       uint32_t timeout = g_stats.timeout;
760:       uint32_t bad_ack = g_stats.bad_ack;
761:       uint8_t epoch = g_recovery_index;
762: 
763:       up_irq_restore(flags);
764:       if (reported == state)
765:         {
766:           continue;
767:         }
768: 
769:       reported = state;
770:       syslog(reported == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY ? LOG_INFO : LOG_WARNING,
771:              "mailbox: link state=%u epoch=%u timeout=%lu bad_ack=%lu\n",
772:              reported, epoch, (unsigned long)timeout,
773:              (unsigned long)bad_ack);
774:       if (callback != NULL)
775:         {
776:           callback(reported, callback_arg);
777:         }
778:     }
779: 
780:   return OK;
781: }

783: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
784: {
785:   (void)argc;
786:   (void)argv;
787: 
788:   for (;;)
789:     {
790:       struct active_transaction *probe;
791:       irqstate_t flags;
792:       bool request_probe;
793: 
794:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
795:       flags = up_irq_save();
796: 
797:       probe = busy_probe();
798:       if ((g_active.busy &&
799:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
800:           (probe != NULL &&
801:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
802:         {
803:           g_stats.timeout++;
804:           if (probe != NULL)
805:             {
806:               probe->quarantine = true;
807:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
808:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
809:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
810:             }
811:           else
812:             {
813:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
814:             }
815:         }
816: 
817:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
818:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)
819:         {
820:           select_recovery_epoch();
821:         }
822: 
823:       (void)dispatch_locked();
824:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
825:                       (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY ||
826:                        g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING) &&
827:                       !g_channels[2].queued && !g_active.busy;
828:       if (request_probe)
829:         {
830:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
831:           g_probe_requested = false;
832:         }
833: 
834:       up_irq_restore(flags);
835: 
836:       if (request_probe)
837:         {
838:           bk7258_mb_uart_start();
839:         }
840:     }
841: 
842:   return OK;
843: }

906: int bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(uint8_t logical_channel,
907:                              const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
908:                              bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback, void *arg)
909: {
910:   struct logical_channel *channel;
911:   unsigned int index;
912:   irqstate_t flags;
913:   int ret;
914: 
915:   if (!g_initialized || !g_physical_started || message == NULL)
916:     {
917:       return -EAGAIN;
918:     }
919: 
920:   index = channel_index(logical_channel);
921:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
922:     {
923:       return -EINVAL;
924:     }
925: 
926:   flags = up_irq_save();
927:   channel = &g_channels[index];
928:   if (channel->queued)
929:     {
930:       up_irq_restore(flags);
931:       return -EBUSY;
932:     }
933: 
934:   if (g_link_state != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
935:       !(g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
936:         logical_channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
937:         bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE))
938:     {
939:       up_irq_restore(flags);
940:       return -ENOLINK;
941:     }
942: 
943:   if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY && g_active.quarantine)
944:     {
945:       up_irq_restore(flags);
946:       return -ENOLINK;
947:     }
948: 
949:   memset(&channel->pending, 0, sizeof(channel->pending));
950:   memcpy(&channel->pending, message, sizeof(channel->pending));
951:   channel->callback = callback;
952:   channel->arg = arg;
953:   channel->result = -EINPROGRESS;
954:   channel->queued = true;
955:   ret = dispatch_locked();
956:   if (ret < 0 && ret != -EAGAIN)
957:     {
958:       channel->queued = false;
959:       channel->result = ret;
960:     }
961: 
962:   up_irq_restore(flags);
963:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
964:   return ret == -EAGAIN ? OK : ret;
965: }

1100: static int wait_channel(uint8_t logical_channel, unsigned int timeout_ms)
1101: {
1102:   unsigned int index = channel_index(logical_channel);
1103:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);
1104: 
1105:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
1106:     {
1107:       return -EINVAL;
1108:     }

54: 				*kind = 1;
55: 				*index = i;
56: 				return &slots->ack[i];
57: 			}
58: 		}
59: 		return NULL;
60: 	}
61: 
62: 	if (ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
63: 	{
64: 		if (slots->sync_used)
65: 			return NULL;
66: 		slots->sync_used = 1;
67: 		slots->sync_order = ++slots->publish_order;
68: 		*kind = 3;
69: 		return &slots->sync;
70: 	}
71: 
72: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
73: 	{
74: 		if (!slots->cmd_used[i])
75: 		{
76: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 1;
77: 			slots->cmd_order[i] = ++slots->publish_order;
78: 			slots->cmd_active = i + 1;
79: 			*kind = 0;
80: 			*index = i;
81: 			return &slots->cmd[i];
82: 		}
83: 	}
84: 
85: 	return NULL;
86: }

88: static void mbox0_release_slot(u8 dst, u8 kind, u8 index)
89: {
90: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
91: 
92: 	if (kind == 0)
93: 	{
94: 		slots->cmd_used[index] = 0;
95: 		if (slots->cmd_active == index + 1)
96: 			slots->cmd_active = 0;
97: 	}
98: 	else if (kind == 1)
99: 	{
100: 		slots->ack_used[index] = 0;
101: 	}
102: 	else if (kind == 2)
103: 	{
104: 		slots->reset_used = 0;
105: 	}
106: 	else
107: 	{
108: 		slots->sync_used = 0;
109: 	}

122: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
123: 	  	extern void flush_dcache(void *va, long size);
124: 		flush_dcache((void *)msg->data[0], sizeof(data));
125: #endif
126: 		memcpy(&data, (u8 *)msg->data[0], sizeof(data));
127: 	}
128: 	else
129: 	{
130: 		return;
131: 	}
132: 
133: 	if(mailbox_callback[chnl] != NULL)
134: 		mailbox_callback[chnl](&data);

171: bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
172: {
173: 	mbox0_message_t message;
174: 	mailbox_data_t *slot;
175: 	u8 ctrl = 0;
176: 	u8 kind = 0;
177: 	u8 index = 0;
178: 
179: 	if(dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
180: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
181: 
182: 	if(data == NULL)
183: 	{
184: 		return BK_FAIL;
185: 	}
186: 	ctrl = (data->param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
187: 
188: 	(void)src;
189: 	(void)arg;
190: 	
191: 	uint32_t fifo_status = 0;
192: 
193: 	int ret_code = mbox0_drv_get_send_stat((uint32_t)dst, &fifo_status);
194: 
195: 	if(ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
196: 	{
197: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
198: 	}
199: 
200: 	if(RX_FIFO_STAT_FULL & fifo_status)
201: 	{
202: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT;  // mailbox busy
203: 	}
204: 
205: 	slot = mbox0_alloc_slot(dst, ctrl, &kind, &index);
206: 	if (slot == NULL)
207: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
208: 
209: 	memcpy(slot, data, sizeof(mailbox_data_t));
210: 
211: 	message.data[0] = (u32)slot;
212: 	message.data[1] = sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
213: 	message.dest_cpu = (uint8_t)dst;
214: 
215: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_send_message(&message);
216: 
217: 	if(ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
218: 	{
219: 		mbox0_release_slot(dst, kind, index);
220: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_NOT_INIT;
221: 	}
222: 
223: 	return BK_OK;
224: }

226: void bk_mailbox_tx_complete(mailbox_endpoint_t dst)
227: {
228: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
229: 	u32 completed_order;
230: 	u8 i;
231: 
232: 	if (dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
233: 		return;
234: 
235: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
236: 	if (slots->cmd_active == 0)
237: 		return;
238: 	completed_order = slots->cmd_order[slots->cmd_active - 1];
239: 
240: 	/* A matching command ACK proves only envelopes published before that
241: 	 * command were copied. ACKs sent after it wait for the STATE probe. */
242: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
243: 	{
244: 		if (slots->ack_used[i] && slots->ack_order[i] < completed_order)
245: 			slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
246: 	}
247: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
248: 	{
249: 		if (slots->cmd_used[i] && slots->cmd_order[i] <= completed_order)
250: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
251: 	}
252: 	if (slots->reset_used && slots->reset_order < completed_order)
253: 		slots->reset_used = 0;
254: 	if (slots->sync_used && slots->sync_order < completed_order)
255: 		slots->sync_used = 0;
256: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
257: }
258: 
259: void bk_mailbox_tx_timeout(mailbox_endpoint_t dst)
260: {
261: 	if (dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
262: 		return;
263: 
264: 	/* Keep the active command slot quarantined. A later matching probe ACK
265: 	 * releases it through bk_mailbox_tx_complete(). */
266: 	mailbox_slots[dst].cmd_active = 0;
267: }

38: {
39: 	volatile u8		tx_state;	/* physical channel tx state. */
40: 	u8		tx_seq;				/* physical channel tx sequence. */
41: 	u8		tx_log_chnl;		/* logical channel. */ /* bit7~bit4: dst/src CPU_ID, bit3~bit0: log_chnl_idx. */
42: 	u8		tx_hdr_cmd;
43: 	u32		rx_fault_cnt;
44: 	u32		tx_fault_cnt;
45: 
46: 	u32		param1;
47: 	u32		param2;
48: 	u32		param3;
49: 	/* Wall-clock (ms via rtos_get_time()) at which tx_state was set to
50: 	 * CHNL_STATE_BUSY. Used by mb_chnl_write() to detect a physical
51: 	 * channel that has been BUSY abnormally long (peer lost / dropped
52: 	 * the ACK) and forcibly clear it. 0 means "channel is IDLE". */
53: 	volatile u32	busy_since_ms;
54: } mb_phy_chnl_cb_t;

59:  *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
60:  *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
61:  *  use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
62:  *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
63:  */

214: {
215: 	mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
216: 	u8 i;
217: 
218: 	for (i = 0; i < count; i++)

222: 		memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
223: 		failure.hdr.cmd = ((mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&logs[i].chnnl_tx_buff)->hdr.cmd;

226: 		if (logs[i].tx_cmpl_isr)

244: static u8 mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
245: {
246: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
247: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
248: 	u16 			chnl_type;
249: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
250: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
251: 
252: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
253: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
254: 
255: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
256: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
257: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
258: 		return 4;
259: #endif
260: 
261: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
262: 		return 5;
263: 
264: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
265: 		return 3;
266: 
267: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
268: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
269: 
270: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
271: 		return 1;
272: 
273: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
274: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
275: 
276: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
277: 
278: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
279: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
280: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
281: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
282: 
283: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
284: 
285: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
286: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
287: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
288: 
289: 	__DMB();
290: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
291: 
292: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
293: 
294: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
295: 
296: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
297: 	{
298: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
299: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
300: 
301: 		return 2;
302: 	}
303: 
304: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
305: 
306: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
307: 
308: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
309: 	{
310: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
311: 	}
312: 
313: 	return 0;
314: }

316: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
317: {
318: 	u8		log_chnl;
319: 	u8		ret_code;
320: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
321: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
322: 
323: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
324: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
325: 
326: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
327: 	if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
328: 	{
329: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
330: 
331: 		phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);
332: 		if (GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl) != SELF_CPU ||
333: 			phy_chnl_idx == SELF_CPU || phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
334: 		{
335: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
336: 			return;
337: 		}
338: 
339: 		phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
340: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx];
341: 		mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x,
342: 				   phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
343: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
344: 		BK_LOGW("mb_chnl", "peer reset cpu=%u active=%x/%u/%u\r\n",
345: 			phy_chnl_idx, phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl,
346: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq, phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd);
347: 
348: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
349: 		{
350: 			log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
351: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
352: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
353: 			{
354: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
355: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
356: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
357: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(
358: 					log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, &failure);
359: 			}
360: 			bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
361: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
362: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
363: 		}
364: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(log_chnl_cb_x,
365: 				     phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]);
366: 		return;
367: 	}
368: 
369: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
370: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
371: 
372: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
373: 
374: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
375: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
376: 		return;
377: 	}
378: 
379: 
380: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
381: 	{
382: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
383: 		return;
384: 	}
385: 
386: 
387: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
388: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
389: 		return;
390: 	}
391: 
392: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
393: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
394: 
395: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
396: 	{
397: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
398: 		return;
399: 	}
400: 
401: 	if ((ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) ||
402: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
403: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
404: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
405: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))
406: 	{
407: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
408: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
409: 
410: 		BK_LOGW("mb_chnl", "stale ack ch=%x seq=%u cmd=%u active=%x/%u/%u\r\n",
411: 			log_chnl, ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq, ack_ptr->hdr.cmd,
412: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl, phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq,
413: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd);
414: 		return;
415: 	}
416: 
417: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
418: 
419: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
420: 	{
421: 		/* clear following header members. */
422: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
423: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
424: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
425: 
426: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
427: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
428: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
429: 	} else {
430: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
431: 	}
432: 
433: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
434: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
435: 	{
436: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
437: 			break;
438: 	}
439: 
440: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
441: 	{
442: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
443: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
444: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
445: 		return;
446: 	}
447: 
448: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
449: 
450: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
451: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
452: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
453: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
454: 
455: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
456: 
457: 	if(ret_code != 0)
458: 	{
459: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
460: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
461: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
462: 	}
463: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
464: 
465: 	return;
466: 
467: }

469: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
470: {
471: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
472: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
473: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
474: 	u16 		chnl_type;
475: 
476: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
477: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
478: 
479: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
480: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
481: 
482: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
483: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
484: 
485: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
486: 
487: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
488: 		return;
489: 
490: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
491: 		return;
492: 
493: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
494: 		return;
495: 
496: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
497: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
498: 
499: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
500: 
501: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
502: 	{
503: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
504: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
505: 
506: 		return;
507: 	}
508: 
509: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
510: 	{
511: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
512: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
513: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
514: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
515: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
516: 
517: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
518: 
519: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
520: 	}
521: 	else
522: 	{
523: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
524: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
525: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
526: 	}
527: 
528: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
529: 	{
530: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
531: 		return;
532: 	}
533: 
534: 	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
535: 
536: 	/* RE-USE the cmd buffer for ACK !!! */
537: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
538: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
539: 
540: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
541: 
542: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
543: 
544: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
545: 
546: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
547: 	{
548: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
549: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
550: 
551: 		return;
552: 	}
553: 
554: 	s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
555: 	mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
556: 		       MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
557: 	return;
558: }

560: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
561: {
562: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
563: 
564: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
565: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
566: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
567: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
568: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
569: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
570: 
571: 	/*
572: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
573: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
574: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
575: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
576: 	 */
577: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
578: 	{
579: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
580: 	}
581: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
582: 	{
583: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
584: 	}
585: }

587: static void mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
588: {
589: 	u8		ret_code;
590: 
591: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
592: 
593: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
594: 
595: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
596: 
597: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
598: 		return;
599: 
600: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
601: 		return;
602: 
603: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
604: 
605: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
606: 	{
607: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
608: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
609: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
610: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
611: 
612: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
613: 
614: 		if(ret_code != 0)
615: 		{
616: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
617: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
618: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
619: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
620: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
621: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
622: 
623: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
624: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
625: 			}
626: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
627: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
628: 		}
629: 	}
630: 
631: 	return;
632: }

634: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
635: 
636: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
637: {
638: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
639: 	u16 			chnl_type;
640: 
641: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
642: 
643: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
644: 
645: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
646: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
647: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
648: #endif
649: 
650: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
651: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
652: 
653: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
654: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
655: 
656: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
657: 
658: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
659: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
660: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
661: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
662: 
663: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
664: 
665: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
666: 	
667: 	/*
668: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
669: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
670: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
671: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
672: 	 */
673: 	while(1)
674: 	{
675: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
676: 
677: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
678: 		{
679: 			break;
680: 		}
681: 	}
682: 
683: 	return ret_code;
684: }

687: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
688: /*
689:   * init logical chnanel module.
690:   * return:
691:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
692:   *     failed  : fail code.
693:   *
694:   */
695: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
696: {
697: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
698: 	int				i, j;
699: 
700: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
701: 
702: 	/*
703: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
704: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
705: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
706: 	 * can race here:
707: 	 *
708: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
709: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
710: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
711: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
712: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
713: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
714: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
715: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
716: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
717: 	 *
718: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
719: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
720: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
721: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
722: 	 */
723: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
724: 	{
725: 		return BK_OK;
726: 	}
727: 
728: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
729: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
730: 	{
731: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
732: 		return BK_OK;
733: 	}
734: 
735: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
736: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
737: 	{
738: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
739: 
740: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
741: 
742: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
743: 
744: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
745: 		{
746: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
747: 		}
748: 	}
749: 
750: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
751: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
752: 	{
753: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
754: 		return ret_code;
755: 	}
756: 
757: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
758: 
759: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
760: 	{
761: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
762: 
763: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
764: 	}
765: 
766: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
767: 
768: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
769: 
770: 	return BK_OK;
771: }

885:   * write to logical chnanel.
886:   * input:
887:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to write.
888:   *     cmd_buf     : buffer of channel cmd data.
889:   * return:
890:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
891:   *     failed  : fail code.
892:   *
893:   */
894: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
895: {
896: 	u16		write_len;
897: 
898: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
899: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
900: 
901: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
902: 
903: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
904: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
905: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
906: #endif
907: 
908: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
909: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
910: 
911: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
912: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
913: 
914: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
915: 
916: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
917: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
918: 
919: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
920: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
921: 
922: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
923: 
924: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
925: 	{
926: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
927: 
928: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
929: 	}
930: 
931: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
932: 
933: 	memset(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, 0,
934: 	       sizeof(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff));

936: 
937: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
938: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
939: 	__DMB();
940: 
941: 	mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
942: 
943: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
944: 
945: 	return BK_OK;
946: }

949:   * logical chnanel misc io (set/get param).
950:   * input:
951:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to set/get param.

956:   *     failed  : fail code.
957:   *
958:   */
959: bk_err_t mb_chnl_ctrl(u8 log_chnl, u8 cmd, void * param)
960: {
961: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
962: 
963: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
964: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
965: 
966: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
967: 
968: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
969: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
970: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
971: #endif
972: 
973: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
974: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
975: 
976: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
977: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;

979: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
980: 
981: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
982: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
983: 
984: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
985: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
986: 
987: 	switch(cmd)
988: 	{
989: 		case MB_CHNL_GET_STATUS:
990: 
991: 			if(param == NULL)
992: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
993: 
994: 			*((u8 *)param) = log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state;
995: 			
996: 			break;
997: 
998: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR:
999: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr = (chnl_rx_isr_t)param;
1000: 			break;
1001: 
1002: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR:
1003: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr = (chnl_tx_isr_t)param;
1004: 			break;
1005: 
1006: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR:
1007: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr = (chnl_tx_cmpl_isr_t)param;
1008: 			break;
1009: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR:
1010: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].event_isr = (chnl_event_isr_t)param;
1011: 			break;
1012: 
1013: 		case MB_CHNL_WRITE_SYNC:
1014: 			if(param == NULL)
1015: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
1016: 
1017: 			ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(log_chnl, (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)param);
1018: 			return ret_code;
1019: 			break;
1020: 
1021: 		default:
1022: 			return BK_ERR_NOT_SUPPORT;
1023: 			break;
1024: 	}
1025: 
1026: 	return BK_OK;
1027: }

1029: void mb_chnl_poll(void)
1030: {
1031: 	u8 phy_idx;
1032: 
1033: 	for (phy_idx = 0; phy_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM; phy_idx++)
1034: 	{
1035: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_idx];
1036: 		mb_log_chnl_cb_t *logs;
1037: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
1038: 		u8 log_idx;
1039: 
1040: 		if ((phy->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY) || !phy->busy_since_ms ||
1041: 			((u32)(rtos_get_time() - phy->busy_since_ms) < MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS))
1042: 			continue;
1043: 
1044: 		logs = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_idx];
1045: 		log_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy->tx_log_chnl);
1046: 		if (log_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx])
1047: 			continue;
1048: 
1049: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt++;
1050: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x20000000;
1051: 		phy->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
1052: 		phy->busy_since_ms = 0;

161: static inline uint32_t mb_uart_enter_critical()
162: {
163: 	uint32_t flags = rtos_disable_int();
164: 
165: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
166: 	spin_lock(&mb_uart_spin_lock);
167: #endif // CONFIG_SOC_SMP
168: 
169: 	return flags;
170: }

172: static inline void mb_uart_exit_critical(uint32_t flags)
173: {
174: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
175: 	spin_unlock(&mb_uart_spin_lock);
176: #endif // CONFIG_SOC_SMP
177: 
178: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
179: }

193: static bool mb_uart_validate_command(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb,
194: 				     mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd, bool data)
195: {
196: 	if (uart_cmd->resvd || uart_cmd->mb_cmd.param3)
197: 		return false;
198: 
199: 	if (data)
200: 	{
201: 		if (uart_cmd->cmd_buff != chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff ||
202: 			uart_cmd->cmd_data_len < 1 ||
203: 			uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > UART_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
204: 			return false;
205: 		return uart_cmd->crc8 == cal_crc8_0x31((u8 *)uart_cmd->cmd_buff,
206: 							 uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
207: 	}
208: 
209: 	return uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL && uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0 &&
210: 		uart_cmd->crc8 == 0;
211: }

213: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
214: {
215: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
216: 
217: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
218: 
219: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
220: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
221: 
222: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
223: 	{
224: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
225: 	}
226: 	else
227: 	{
228: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
229: 	}
230: 
231: 	if(!mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, true))
232: 	{
233: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
234: 		tx_fail = 1;
235: 		BK_LOGW(MOD_TAG, "bad DATA ptr=%p expected=%p len=%u flags=%x crc=%x rsv=%x\r\n",
236: 			uart_cmd->cmd_buff, chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff,
237: 			uart_cmd->cmd_data_len, uart_cmd->resvd,
238: 			uart_cmd->crc8, uart_cmd->mb_cmd.param3);
239: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
240: 	}
241: 
242: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
243: 	{
244: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
245: 		tx_fail = 1;
246: 		
247: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
248: 	}
249: 
250: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
251: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
252: 	#endif
253: 
254: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
255: 
256: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
257: 
258: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
259: 	{
260: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
261: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
262: 	}
263: 	else
264: 	{
265: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
266: 
267: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
268: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
269: 
270: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
271: 		{
272: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
273: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
274: 		}
275: 		else
276: 		{
277: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
278: 
279: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
280: 			{
281: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
282: 			}
283: 
284: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
285: 		}
286: 	}
287: 
288: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
289: 
290: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
291: 	{
292: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
293: 	}
294: 
295: rx_isr_data_xit:
296: 	
297: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
298: 	{
299: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
300: 	}
301: 
302: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
303: 
304: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
305: 
306: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
307: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
308: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
309: 	 */
310: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
311: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
312: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
313: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
314: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
315: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
316: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
317: 
318: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
319: 	{
320: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
321: 		{
322: 			/* trigger send! */
323: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
324: 		}
325: 	}
326: 	
327: 	return;
328: }

330: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
331: {
332: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
333: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
334: 	u8 invalid = !mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, false);
335: 
336: 	if (!invalid)
337: 		chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
338: 	else
339: 	{
340: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
341: 		BK_LOGW(MOD_TAG, "bad STATE payload=%p len=%u flags=%x crc=%x rsv=%x\r\n",
342: 			uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len,
343: 			uart_cmd->resvd, uart_cmd->crc8, uart_cmd->mb_cmd.param3);
344: 	}
345: 
346: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
347: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
348: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
349: 	 */
350: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
351: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
352: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
353: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
354: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = invalid;
355: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
356: 
357: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
358: 	{
359: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
360: 		{
361: 			/* trigger send! */
362: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
363: 		}
364: 	}
365: 
366: 	return;
367: }
