369: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
370: {
371: 	/* clear here, because rts state will be passed in response data! */
372: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
373: 	
374: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
375: 	{
376: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
377: 	}
378: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
379: 	{
380: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
381: 	}
382: 	else
383: 	{
384: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
385: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
386: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
387: 		 */
388: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
389: 		u8 cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
390: 		memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
391: 		uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
392: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
393: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
394: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
395: 	}
396: 	
397: 	return;
398: }

400: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
401: {
402: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
403: 
404: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
405: 
406: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
407: 
408: 	if( (ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) || 
409: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
410: 	{
411: 		/*
412: 		 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
413: 		 */
414: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault tx_cmd:%x, rsp_cmd:%x\r\n", chnl_cb->tx_cmd, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
415: 
416: 		return;
417: 	}
418: 
419: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
420: 
421: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
422: 	{
423: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
424: 	}
425: 	else if ((uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data1 & ~0x3u) ||
426: 		 uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data2 || uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data3)
427: 	{
428: 		tx_fail = 1;
429: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
430: 	}
431: 	else
432: 	{
433: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
434: 	}
435: 
436: 	if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
437: 	{
438: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx + chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
439: 					 sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
440: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
441: 		chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
442: 	}
443: 	else if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
444: 	{
445: 		if (!chnl_cb->link_ready)
446: 		{
447: 			chnl_cb->link_ready = 1;
448: 			BK_LOGI(MOD_TAG, "link ready ch=%x cts=%u\r\n",
449: 				chnl_cb->chnl_id, chnl_cb->status_cts);
450: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_READY);
451: 		}
452: 	}
453: 
454: 	if (tx_fail)
455: 	{
456: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
457: 		{
458: 			if (chnl_cb->tx_retry)
459: 			{
460: 				chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
461: 						      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
462: 						     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
463: 				chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
464: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
465: 			}
466: 			else
467: 			{
468: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 1;
469: 			}
470: 		}
471: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
472: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
473: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;
474: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
475: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "TX fail cmd=%u state=%x remote=%u\r\n",
476: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd, ack_buf->hdr.state, uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail);
477: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
478: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
479: 			chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
480: 		return;
481: 	}
482: 
483: 	/* try next Tx. */
484: 
485: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
486: 
487: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
488: 	{
489: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
490: 		if (ret_val == BK_OK)
491: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
492: 	}
493: 	if (ret_val != BK_OK)
494: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
495: 
496: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
497: 	{
498: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
499: 	}
500: 
501: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
502: 	{
503: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
504: 	}
505: 
506: 	return;
507: }

509: static void mb_uart_channel_event(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_event_t event)
510: {
511: 	if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT)
512: 	{
513: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
514: 	}
515: 	else
516: 	{
517: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len)
518: 		{
519: 			/* Delivery is unknowable after a lost ACK. Drop this chunk instead
520: 			 * of replaying terminal input and making duplicate commands. */
521: 			chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
522: 					      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
523: 					     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
524: 			chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
525: 			chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
526: 			chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
527: 		}
528: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
529: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
530: 		if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET)
531: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
532: 		else
533: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_TIMEOUT);
534: 	}
535: 
536: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
537: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
538: }

540: static bk_err_t mb_uart_init(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
541: {
542: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
543: 
544: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
545: 		return BK_OK;
546: 
547: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(mb_uart_cb_t));
548: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
549: 
550: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
551: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
552: 
553: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) ||
554: 		(chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
555: 	{
556: 		return BK_FAIL;
557: 	}
558: 
559: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
560: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
561: 	{
562: 		return ret_code;
563: 	}
564: 
565: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_rx_isr);
566: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr);
567: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR, NULL);
568: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_channel_event);
569: 
570: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
571: 
572: 	return BK_OK;
573: }

575: static bk_err_t mb_uart_deinit(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
576: {
577: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
578: 		return BK_OK;
579: 
580: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, NULL);
581: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, NULL);
582: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR, NULL);
583: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR, NULL);
584: 
585: 	mb_chnl_close(chnl_id);
586: 
587: 	chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback = NULL;
588: 	chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback = NULL;
589: 
590: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 0;
591: 
592: 	return BK_OK;
593: }

595: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
596: {
597: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
598: 
599: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
600: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
601: 
602: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
603: 	{
604: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
605: 	}
606: 
607: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
608: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
609: 
610: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
611: 	{
612: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
613: 	}
614: 	else
615: 	{
616: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
617: 	}
618: 
619: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
620: 	{
621: 		return BK_FAIL;
622: 	}
623: 
624: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
625: 	{
626: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
627: 	}
628: 
629: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
630: 	{
631: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
632: 	}
633: 	else
634: 	{
635: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
636: 
637: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
638: 		{
639: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
640: 		}
641: 		else
642: 		{
643: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
644: 
645: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
646: 		}
647: 	}
648: 
649: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
650: 
651: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
652: 
653: 	memset(&uart_cmd, 0, sizeof(uart_cmd));
654: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
655: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
656: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
657: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
658: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
659: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);
660: 
661: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
662: 
663: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
664: 	{
665: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = cpy_len;
666: 	}
667: 
668: 	return ret_val;
669: }

671: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
672: {
673: 	u32 flag = mb_uart_enter_critical();
674: 
675: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_in_process != 0)
676: 	{
677: 		mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
678: 		return BK_OK;
679: 	}
680: 
681: 	chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 1;
682: 
683: 	mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
684: 
685: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
686: 
687: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
688: 
689: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
690: 	{
691: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */

745: static u16 mb_uart_write_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 data_len)
746: {
747: 	u16    rem_len, wr_len;
748: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
749: 	
750: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
751: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
752: 
753: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
754: 	{
755: 		rem_len = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
756: 	}
757: 	else
758: 	{
759: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
760: 	}
761: 
762: 	wr_len = data_len;
763: 	if(wr_len > rem_len)
764: 		wr_len = rem_len;
765: 
766: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
767: 	{
768: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
769: 	}
770: 	else
771: 	{
772: 		if(rd_idx != 0)
773: 			rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - wr_idx;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
774: 
775: 		if(rem_len >= wr_len)
776: 		{
777: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
778: 		}
779: 		else
780: 		{
781: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, rem_len);
782: 
783: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf, data_buf + rem_len, wr_len - rem_len);
784: 		}
785: 	}
786: 
787: 	chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx = (wr_idx + wr_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
788: 
789: 	/* trigger send! */
790: 	mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
791: 
792: 	return wr_len;
793: }

795: static u16 mb_uart_read_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 buf_len)
796: {
797: 	u16    rem_len, rd_len;
798: 
799: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
800: 		return 0;
801: 
802: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, data_cnt;
803: 
804: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
805: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
806: 
807: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
808: 	{
809: 		data_cnt = wr_idx - rd_idx;
810: 	}
811: 	else
812: 	{
813: 		data_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
814: 	}
815: 
816: 	rd_len = data_cnt;
817: 	if(rd_len > buf_len)
818: 		rd_len = buf_len;
819: 
820: 	if(rd_len == 0)
821: 	{
822: 		return 0;
823: 	}
824: 
825: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
826: 	{
827: 		memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
828: 		chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
829: 	}
830: 	else
831: 	{
832: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - rd_idx;
833: 
834: 		if(rem_len > rd_len)
835: 		{
836: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
837: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
838: 		}
839: 		else
840: 		{
841: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
842: 			if(rem_len < rd_len)
843: 			{
844: 				memcpy(data_buf + rem_len, chnl_cb->rx_buf, rd_len - rem_len);
845: 			}
846: 
847: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx = rd_len - rem_len;
848: 		}
849: 	}
850: 
851: 	data_cnt -= rd_len;
852: 
853: 	/* rts assert...... */
854: 	if(data_cnt < ((sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - 1 - MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN) * 8 / 10))
855: 	{
856: 		if( chnl_cb->ctrl_rts != 0)
857: 		{
858: 			chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 0;
859: 			mb_uart_send_state_trigger(chnl_cb);
860: 		}
861: 	}
862: 
863: 	return rd_len;
864: 
865: }

256: ## 7. UART0 Mailbox V2 使用和边界
257: 
258: CP 启动后默认 owner 为 `CP_CLI`。只有 MB_UART0 STATE 成功 ACK、IPC power-up 和
259: PWC boot-ready 三个条件同时成立，且`bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`非零时，
260: `ap_console open`才允许进入。heartbeat timeout、AP reset/power-off 和 Mailbox
261: reset/timeout都会清除门禁并请求回退到CP CLI。使用方式：
262: 
263: ```text
264: ap_console status
265: ap_console open
266: <RAW AP NSH interaction>
267: <at line start press Ctrl-], then .>
268: ap_console status
269: ```
270: 
271: `open`在当前 CP CLI 响应经 UART TX-complete 后生效，并清 CP parser 和 UART RX；
272: RAW 模式不添加前缀。退出转义只在行首识别，链路 reset/timeout/down 时自动清理
273: 未发送输入并回到 `CP_CLI`。`status`输出 owner/link/mode、bridge ring、MB_UART 状态、
274: active channel/sequence/command 和 drop/partial/overflow/reset/timeout 统计。

57: static void mbox0_reap_slots(u8 dst)
58: {
59: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
60: 	uint32_t fifo_count;
61: 	u32 reaped = 0;
62: 	u32 now;
63: 	u8 i;
64: 
65: 	if (mbox0_drv_get_send_count(dst, &fifo_count) != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
66: 		return;
67: 
68: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
69: 	if (fifo_count != 0)
70: 	{
71: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
72: 		return;
73: 	}
74: 
75: 	now = rtos_get_time();
76: 	if (!slots->fifo_empty_since_ms)
77: 	{
78: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = now ? now : 1;
79: 		return;
80: 	}
81: 	if ((u32)(now - slots->fifo_empty_since_ms) <
82: 		MBOX0_SLOT_QUARANTINE_MS)
83: 		return;
84: 
85: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
86: 	{
87: 		reaped += slots->cmd_used[i] != 0;
88: 		slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
89: 	}
90: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
91: 	{
92: 		reaped += slots->ack_used[i] != 0;
93: 		slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
94: 	}
95: 	reaped += slots->reset_used != 0;
96: 	reaped += slots->sync_used != 0;
97: 	slots->reset_used = 0;
98: 	slots->sync_used = 0;
99: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
100: 	slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
101: 	adapter_diag.tx_reaped += reaped;
102: }

109: static mbox0_rx_desc_t *mbox0_oldest_desc(bool priority)
110: {
111: 	mbox0_rx_desc_t *oldest = NULL;
112: 	u8 i;
113: 
114: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM; i++)
115: 	{
116: 		u8 ctrl;
117: 
118: 		if (!rx_desc[i].used)
119: 			continue;
120: 		ctrl = (rx_desc[i].data.param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
121: 		if (((ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0) != priority)
122: 			continue;
123: 		if (!oldest || (int32_t)(rx_desc[i].order - oldest->order) < 0)
124: 			oldest = &rx_desc[i];
125: 	}
126: 	return oldest;
127: }

129: static mbox0_stable_slot_t *mbox0_alloc_slot(u8 dst, u8 ctrl,
130: 					     u8 *kind, u8 *index)
131: {
132: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
133: 	u8 i;
134: 
135: 	if (ctrl == (MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX | MBOX0_CTRL_RESET))
136: 	{
137: 		if (slots->reset_used)
138: 			return NULL;
139: 		slots->reset_used = 1;
140: 		slots->reset_order = ++slots->publish_order;
141: 		*kind = 2;
142: 		return &slots->reset;
143: 	}
144: 
145: 	if (ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
146: 	{
147: 		for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
148: 		{
149: 			if (!slots->ack_used[i])
150: 			{
151: 				slots->ack_used[i] = 1;
152: 				slots->ack_order[i] = ++slots->publish_order;
153: 				*kind = 1;
154: 				*index = i;
155: 				return &slots->ack[i];
156: 			}
157: 		}
158: 		return NULL;
159: 	}
160: 
161: 	if (ctrl == MBOX0_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
162: 	{
163: 		if (slots->sync_used)
164: 			return NULL;
165: 		slots->sync_used = 1;
166: 		slots->sync_order = ++slots->publish_order;
167: 		*kind = 3;
168: 		return &slots->sync;
169: 	}
170: 
171: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
172: 	{
173: 		if (!slots->cmd_used[i])
174: 		{
175: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 1;
176: 			slots->cmd_order[i] = ++slots->publish_order;
177: 			slots->cmd_active = i + 1;
178: 			*kind = 0;
179: 			*index = i;
180: 			return &slots->cmd[i];
181: 		}
182: 	}
183: 
184: 	return NULL;
185: }

187: static void mbox0_release_slot(u8 dst, u8 kind, u8 index)
188: {
189: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
190: 
191: 	if (kind == 0)
192: 	{
193: 		slots->cmd_used[index] = 0;
194: 		if (slots->cmd_active == index + 1)
195: 			slots->cmd_active = 0;
196: 	}
197: 	else if (kind == 1)
198: 		slots->ack_used[index] = 0;
199: 	else if (kind == 2)
200: 		slots->reset_used = 0;
201: 	else
202: 		slots->sync_used = 0;
203: }

205: void bk_mailbox_poll(void)
206: {
207: 	u8 dst;
208: 
209: 	u32 flags = rtos_disable_int();
210: 	for (dst = 0; dst < MBOX_CHNL_NUM; dst++)
211: 	{
212: 		if (dst != MAILBOX_CPU0)
213: 			mbox0_reap_slots(dst);
214: 	}
215: 	mbox0_drv_poll();
216: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
217: 
218: 	while (1)
219: 	{
220: 		mbox0_rx_desc_t desc;
221: 		mbox0_rx_desc_t *selected;
222: 
223: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
224: 		if (!rx_count)
225: 		{
226: 			rtos_enable_int(flags);
227: 			break;
228: 		}
229: 		selected = mbox0_oldest_desc(true);
230: 		if (!selected)
231: 			selected = mbox0_oldest_desc(false);
232: 		if (!selected ||
233: 			(((selected->data.param0 >> 12) & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 &&
234: 			 upper_rx_ready && !upper_rx_ready()))
235: 		{
236: 			rtos_enable_int(flags);
237: 			break;
238: 		}
239: 		desc = *selected;
240: 		selected->used = 0;
241: 		rx_count--;
242: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
243: 		if (mailbox_callback[desc.source])
244: 			mailbox_callback[desc.source](&desc.data);
245: 
246: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
247: 		mbox0_drv_poll();
248: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
249: 	}
250: }

252: static void mbox0_rx_isr(mbox0_message_t *msg)
253: {
254: 	u32 address;
255: 	u32 source;
256: 	mbox0_rx_desc_t *desc;
257: 	u8 i;
258: 
259: 	if (!msg)
260: 		return;
261: 
262: 	source = msg->src_cpu;
263: 	if (source != MAILBOX_CPU1)
264: 	{
265: 		adapter_diag.bad_sid++;
266: 		return;
267: 	}
268: 	if (msg->data[1] != sizeof(mailbox_data_t))
269: 	{
270: 		adapter_diag.bad_length++;
271: 		return;
272: 	}
273: 
274: 	address = msg->data[0];
275: 	if (address & 0x3u)
276: 	{
277: 		adapter_diag.bad_alignment++;
278: 		return;
279: 	}
280: 	if (address > UINT32_MAX - sizeof(mailbox_data_t) ||
281: 		address < MBOX0_AP_RAM_START ||
282: 		address + sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > MBOX0_AP_RAM_END)
283: 	{
284: 		adapter_diag.bad_address++;
285: 		return;
286: 	}
287: 	if (rx_count >= MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM)
288: 	{
289: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
290: 		return;
291: 	}
292: 
293: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
294: 	SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((void *)address, sizeof(mailbox_data_t));
295: #endif
296: 	__DMB();
297: 	desc = NULL;
298: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM; i++)
299: 	{
300: 		if (!rx_desc[i].used)
301: 		{
302: 			desc = &rx_desc[i];
303: 			break;
304: 		}
305: 	}
306: 	if (!desc)
307: 	{
308: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
309: 		return;
310: 	}
311: 	memcpy(&desc->data, (void *)address, sizeof(desc->data));
312: 	desc->source = source;
313: 	desc->order = ++rx_order;
314: 	desc->used = 1;
315: 	rx_count++;
316: 
317: }

349: bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src,
350: 			 mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
351: {
352: 	mbox0_message_t message;
353: 	mbox0_stable_slot_t *slot;
354: 	uint32_t fifo_status;
355: 	u8 ctrl;
356: 	u8 kind = 0;
357: 	u8 index = 0;
358: 	int ret_code;
359: 
360: 	(void)arg;
361: 	if (src != MAILBOX_CPU0 || dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
362: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
363: 	if (!data)
364: 		return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
365: 
366: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_get_send_stat(dst, &fifo_status);
367: 	if (ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
368: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
369: 	if (fifo_status & RX_FIFO_STAT_FULL)
370: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT;
371: 
372: 	ctrl = (data->param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
373: 	mbox0_reap_slots(dst);
374: 	slot = mbox0_alloc_slot(dst, ctrl, &kind, &index);
375: 	if (!slot)
376: 	{
377: 		adapter_diag.tx_slot_busy++;
378: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
379: 	}
380: 
381: 	memset(slot, 0, sizeof(*slot));
382: 	memcpy(&slot->data, data, sizeof(slot->data));
383: 	mailbox_slots[dst].fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
384: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
385: 	SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((u32 *)slot, sizeof(*slot));
386: #endif
387: 	__DMB();
388: 	message.data[0] = (u32)&slot->data;
389: 	message.data[1] = sizeof(slot->data);
390: 	message.dest_cpu = dst;
391: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_send_message(&message);
392: 	if (ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
393: 	{
394: 		mbox0_release_slot(dst, kind, index);
395: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_NOT_INIT;
396: 	}
397: 	return BK_OK;
398: }

400: void bk_mailbox_tx_complete(mailbox_endpoint_t dst)
401: {
402: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
403: 	u32 completed_order;
404: 	u8 i;
405: 
406: 	if (dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
407: 		return;
408: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
409: 	if (!slots->cmd_active)
410: 		return;
411: 	completed_order = slots->cmd_order[slots->cmd_active - 1];
412: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
413: 	{
414: 		if (slots->ack_used[i] && slots->ack_order[i] < completed_order)
415: 			slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
416: 	}
417: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
418: 	{
419: 		if (slots->cmd_used[i] && slots->cmd_order[i] <= completed_order)
420: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
421: 	}
422: 	if (slots->reset_used && slots->reset_order < completed_order)
423: 		slots->reset_used = 0;
424: 	if (slots->sync_used && slots->sync_order < completed_order)
425: 		slots->sync_used = 0;
426: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
427: }

432: 		mailbox_slots[dst].cmd_active = 0;

209: static inline bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send_safe(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
210: {
211: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
212: 	
213: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
214: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(data, src, dst, arg);
215: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
216: 	
217: 	return ret_code;
218: }

220: static bool mb_chnl_rx_ready(void)
221: {
222: 	return ack_count < MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
223: }

225: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
226: {
227: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
228: 
229: 	while (1)
230: 	{
231: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
232: 		bk_err_t ret;
233: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
234: 
235: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
236: 		{
237: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
238: 			return;
239: 		}
240: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
241: 		ack_sending = 1;
242: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
243: 
244: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
245: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
246: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
247: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
248: 		{
249: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry.destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
250: 			ack_sending = 0;
251: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
252: 			return;
253: 		}
254: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
255: 		ack_count--;
256: 		ack_sending = 0;
257: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
258: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
259: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
260: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],
261: 			MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
262: 	}
263: }
264: 
265: static bool mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(u8 destination, const mailbox_data_t *data)
266: {
267: 	u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
268: 	mb_ack_entry_t *entry;
269: 
270: 	if (ack_count >= MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN)
271: 	{
272: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[destination].ack_queue_full_cnt++;
273: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
274: 		return false;
275: 	}
276: 	entry = &ack_queue[ack_write];
277: 	entry->data = *data;
278: 	entry->destination = destination;
279: 	ack_write = (ack_write + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
280: 	ack_count++;
281: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
282: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
283: 	return true;
284: }

329: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
330: {
331: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
332: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
333: 	u16 			chnl_type;
334: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
335: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
336: 
337: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
338: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
339: 
340: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
341: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
342: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
343: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
344: #endif
345: 
346: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
347: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
348: 
349: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
350: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
351: 
352: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
353: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
354: 
355: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
356: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
357: 
358: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
359: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
360: 
361: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
362: 
363: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
364: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
365: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
366: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
367: 
368: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
369: 
370: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
371: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
372: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
373: 
374: 	__DMB();
375: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
376: 
377: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
378: 
379: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
380: 
381: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
382: 	{
383: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
384: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
385: 
386: 		return ret_code;
387: 	}
388: 
389: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
390: 
391: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
392: 
393: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
394: 	{
395: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
396: 	}
397: 
398: 	return BK_OK;
399: }

401: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
402: {
403: 	u8		log_chnl;
404: 	u8		ret_code;
405: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
406: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
407: 
408: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
409: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
410: 
411: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
412: 	if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
413: 	{
414: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
415: 
416: 		phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);
417: 		if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != (CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX | CHNL_CTRL_RESET) ||
418: 			ack_ptr->hdr.state != 0 || ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != 0 ||
419: 			ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != 0 || ack_ptr->data1 != 0 ||
420: 			ack_ptr->data2 != 0 || ack_ptr->data3 != 0 ||
421: 			GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl) != SELF_CPU ||
422: 			phy_chnl_idx == SELF_CPU || phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
423: 		{
424: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
425: 			if (phy_chnl_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM)
426: 				phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx].reset_bad_cnt++;
427: 			return;
428: 		}
429: 
430: 		phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
431: 		phy_chnl_ptr->recovering = 1;
432: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx];
433: 		mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x,
434: 				   phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
435: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
436: 		u32 reset_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
437: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
438: 		{
439: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
440: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
441: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
442: 			log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
443: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
444: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
445: 			{
446: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
447: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
448: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
449: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(
450: 					log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, &failure);
451: 			}
452: 			bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
453: 		}
454: 		else
455: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
456: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(log_chnl_cb_x,
457: 				     phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]);
458: 		return;
459: 	}
460: 
461: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
462: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
463: 
464: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
465: 
466: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
467: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
468: 		return;
469: 	}
470: 
471: 
472: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
473: 	{
474: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
475: 		return;
476: 	}
477: 
478: 
479: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
480: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
481: 		return;
482: 	}
483: 
484: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
485: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
486: 
487: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
488: 	{
489: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
490: 		return;
491: 	}
492: 
493: 	u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
494: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY ||
495: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) ||
496: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
497: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
498: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
499: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))
500: 	{
501: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
502: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
503: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
504: 		return;
505: 	}
506: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
507: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
508: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
509: 
510: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
511: 
512: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
513: 	{
514: 		/* clear following header members. */
515: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
516: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
517: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
518: 
519: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
520: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
521: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
522: 	} else {
523: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
524: 	}
525: 
526: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
527: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
528: 	{
529: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
530: 		return;
531: 	}
532: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
533: 	{
534: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
535: 			break;
536: 	}
537: 
538: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
539: 	{
540: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
541: 		return;
542: 	}
543: 
544: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
545: 
546: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
547: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
548: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
549: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
550: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
551: 
552: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
553: 
554: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
555: 	{
556: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
557: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
558: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
559: 	}
560: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
561: 
562: 	return;
563: 
564: }

566: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
567: {
568: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
569: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
570: 
571: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
572: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
573: 
574: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
575: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
576: 
577: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
578: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
579: 
580: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
581: 
582: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
583: 		return;
584: 
585: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
586: 		return;
587: 
588: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
589: 		return;
590: 
591: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
592: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
593: 
594: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
595: 
596: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
597: 	{
598: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
599: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
600: 
601: 		return;
602: 	}
603: 
604: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
605: 	{
606: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
607: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
608: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
609: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
610: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
611: 
612: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
613: 
614: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
615: 	}
616: 	else
617: 	{
618: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
619: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
620: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
621: 	}
622: 
623: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
624: 	{
625: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
626: 		return;
627: 	}
628: 
629: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
630: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
631: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
632: 
633: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))
634: 	{
635: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
636: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
637: 		return;
638: 	}
639: 	return;
640: }

642: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
643: {
644: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
645: 
646: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
647: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
648: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
649: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
650: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
651: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
652: 
653: 	/*
654: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
655: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
656: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
657: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
658: 	 */
659: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
660: 	{
661: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
662: 	}
663: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
664: 	{
665: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
666: 	}
667: }

669: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
670: {
671: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
672: 
673: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
674: 
675: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
676: 
677: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
678: 
679: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
680: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
681: 
682: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
683: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
684: 
685: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
686: 
687: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
688: 	{
689: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
690: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
691: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
692: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
693: 
694: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
695: 
696: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
697: 		{
698: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
699: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
700: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
701: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
702: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
703: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
704: 
705: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
706: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
707: 			}
708: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
709: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
710: 			return ret_code;
711: 		}
712: 	}
713: 
714: 	return BK_OK;
715: }

717: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;

719: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
720: {
721: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
722: 	u16 			chnl_type;
723: 
724: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
725: 
726: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
727: 
728: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
729: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
730: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
731: #endif
732: 
733: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
734: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
735: 
736: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
737: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
738: 
739: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
740: 
741: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
742: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
743: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
744: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
745: 
746: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
747: 
748: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
749: 	
750: 	/*
751: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
752: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
753: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
754: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
755: 	 */
756: 	while(1)
757: 	{
758: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
759: 
760: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
761: 		{
762: 			break;
763: 		}
764: 	}
765: 
766: 	return ret_code;
767: }

770: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
771: /*
772:   * init logical chnanel module.
773:   * return:
774:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
775:   *     failed  : fail code.
776:   *
777:   */
778: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
779: {
780: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
781: 	int				i, j;
782: 
783: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
784: 
785: 	/*
786: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
787: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
788: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
789: 	 * can race here:
790: 	 *
791: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
792: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
793: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
794: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
795: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
796: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
797: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
798: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
799: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
800: 	 *
801: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
802: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
803: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
804: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
805: 	 */
806: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
807: 	{
808: 		return BK_OK;
809: 	}
810: 
811: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
812: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
813: 	{
814: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
815: 		return BK_OK;
816: 	}
817: 
818: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
819: 	memset(ack_queue, 0, sizeof(ack_queue));
820: 	ack_read = 0;
821: 	ack_write = 0;
822: 	ack_count = 0;
823: 	ack_sending = 0;
824: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
825: 	{
826: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
827: 
828: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
829: 
830: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
831: 
832: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
833: 		{
834: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
835: 		}
836: 	}
837: 
838: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
839: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
840: 	{
841: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
842: 		return ret_code;
843: 	}
844: 
845: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
846: 
847: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
848: 	{
849: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
850: 
851: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
852: 	}
853: 
854: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
855: 	bk_mailbox_rx_ready_callback_register(mb_chnl_rx_ready);
856: 
857: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
858: 
859: 	return BK_OK;
860: }

973: /*
974:   * write to logical chnanel.
975:   * input:
976:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to write.
977:   *     cmd_buf     : buffer of channel cmd data.
978:   * return:
979:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
980:   *     failed  : fail code.
981:   *
982:   */
983: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
984: {
985: 	u16		write_len;
986: 
987: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
988: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
989: 
990: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
991: 
992: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
993: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
994: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
995: #endif
996: 
997: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
998: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
999: 
1000: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
1001: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1002: 
1003: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
1004: 
1005: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
1006: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1007: 
1008: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
1009: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
1010: 
1011: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1012: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
1013: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t *logical_cmd = cmd_buf;
1014: 
1015: 	if (phy->recovering &&
1016: 		!(log_chnl == MB_CHNL_UART0 &&
1017: 		  logical_cmd->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_STATE_COMMAND))
1018: 	{
1019: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1020: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1021: 	}
1022: 
1023: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
1024: 	{
1025: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1026: 
1027: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1028: 	}
1029: 
1030: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
1031: 
1032: 	memset(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, 0,
1033: 	       sizeof(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff));
1034: 	memcpy(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, cmd_buf, write_len);
1035: 
1036: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
1037: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
1038: 	__DMB();
1039: 
1040: 	bk_err_t start_ret = mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
1041: 
1042: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1043: 
1044: 	return start_ret;
1045: }

1047: /*
1048:   * logical chnanel misc io (set/get param).
1049:   * input:
1050:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to set/get param.
1051:   *     cmd          : control command for logical channel.
1052:   *     param      :  parameter of the command.

1054:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
1055:   *     failed  : fail code.
1056:   *
1057:   */
1058: bk_err_t mb_chnl_ctrl(u8 log_chnl, u8 cmd, void * param)
1059: {
1060: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
1061: 
1062: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
1063: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
1064: 
1065: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
1066: 
1067: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
1068: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
1069: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1070: #endif
1071: 
1072: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
1073: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1074: 
1075: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
1076: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1077: 
1078: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
1079: 
1080: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
1081: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1082: 
1083: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
1084: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
1085: 
1086: 	switch(cmd)
1087: 	{
1088: 		case MB_CHNL_GET_STATUS:
1089: 
1090: 			if(param == NULL)
1091: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
1092: 
1093: 			*((u8 *)param) = log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state;
1094: 			
1095: 			break;
1096: 
1097: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR:
1098: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr = (chnl_rx_isr_t)param;
1099: 			break;
1100: 
1101: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR:
1102: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr = (chnl_tx_isr_t)param;
1103: 			break;
1104: 
1105: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR:
1106: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr = (chnl_tx_cmpl_isr_t)param;
1107: 			break;
1108: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR:
1109: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].event_isr = (chnl_event_isr_t)param;
1110: 			break;
1111: 
1112: 		case MB_CHNL_WRITE_SYNC:
1113: 			if(param == NULL)
1114: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
1115: 
1116: 			ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(log_chnl, (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)param);
1117: 			return ret_code;
1118: 			break;
1119: 
1120: 		default:
1121: 			return BK_ERR_NOT_SUPPORT;
1122: 			break;
1123: 	}
1124: 
1125: 	return BK_OK;
1126: }

1128: void mb_chnl_poll(void)
1129: {
1130: 	u8 phy_idx;
1131: 
1132: 	bk_mailbox_poll();
1133: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
1134: 
1135: 	for (phy_idx = 0; phy_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM; phy_idx++)
1136: 	{
1137: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_idx];
1138: 		mb_log_chnl_cb_t *logs;
1139: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
1140: 		u8 log_idx;
1141: 
1142: 		u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1143: 		if ((phy->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY) || !phy->busy_since_ms ||
1144: 			((u32)(rtos_get_time() - phy->busy_since_ms) < MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS))
1145: 		{
1146: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1147: 			continue;
1148: 		}
1149: 		phy->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
1150: 		phy->busy_since_ms = 0;
1151: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1152: 
1153: 		logs = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_idx];
1154: 		log_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy->tx_log_chnl);

221: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
222: {
223: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
224: 
225: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
226: 
227: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
228: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
229: 
230: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
231: 	{
232: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
233: 	}
234: 	else
235: 	{
236: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
237: 	}
238: 
239: 	if(!mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, true))
240: 	{
241: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
242: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
243: 		tx_fail = 1;
244: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
245: 	}
246: 
247: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
248: 	{
249: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
250: 		tx_fail = 1;
251: 		
252: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
253: 	}
254: 
255: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
256: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
257: 	#endif
258: 
259: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
260: 
261: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
262: 
263: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
264: 	{
265: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
266: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
267: 	}
268: 	else
269: 	{
270: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
271: 
272: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
273: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
274: 
275: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
276: 		{
277: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
278: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
279: 		}
280: 		else
281: 		{
282: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
283: 
284: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
285: 			{
286: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
287: 			}
288: 
289: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
290: 		}
291: 	}
292: 
293: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
294: 
295: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
296: 	{
297: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
298: 	}
299: 
300: rx_isr_data_xit:
301: 	
302: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
303: 	{
304: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
305: 	}
306: 
307: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
308: 
309: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
310: 
311: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
312: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
313: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
314: 	 */
315: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
316: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
317: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
318: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
319: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
320: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
321: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
322: 
323: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
324: 	{
325: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
326: 		{
327: 			/* trigger send! */
328: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
329: 		}
330: 	}
331: 	
332: 	return;
333: }

335: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
336: {

338: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
339: 	u8 invalid = !mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, false);
340:

346: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;

350: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
351: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
352: 	 */
353: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
354: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
355: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
356: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
357: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = invalid;
358: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
359: 
360: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)

372: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
373: {
374: 	/* clear here, because rts state will be passed in response data! */
375: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
376: 	
377: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
378: 	{
379: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
380: 	}
381: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
382: 	{
383: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
384: 	}
385: 	else
386: 	{
387: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
388: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
389: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
390: 		 */
391: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
392: 		u8 cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
393: 		memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
394: 		uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
395: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
396: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
397: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
398: 	}
399: 	
400: 	return;
401: }

403: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
404: {
405: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
406: 
407: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
408: 
409: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
410: 
411: 	if ((ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) ||
412: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
413: 	{
414: 		chnl_cb->bad_ack_count++;
415: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
416: 		return;
417: 	}
418: 
419: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
420: 
421: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
422: 	{
423: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
424: 	}
425: 	else if ((uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data1 & ~0x3u) ||
426: 		 uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data2 || uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data3)
427: 	{
428: 		tx_fail = 1;
429: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
430: 	}
431: 	else
432: 	{
433: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
434: 	}
435: 
436: 	if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
437: 	{
438: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx + chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
439: 					 sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
440: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
441: 		chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
442: 	}
443: 	else if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
444: 	{
445: 		if (!chnl_cb->link_ready)
446: 		{
447: 			chnl_cb->link_ready = 1;
448: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_READY;
449: 			chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
450: 			mb_chnl_recovered(GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id));
451: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_READY);
452: 		}
453: 	}
454: 
455: 	if (tx_fail)
456: 	{
457: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
458: 		{
459: 			if (chnl_cb->tx_retry)
460: 			{
461: 				chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
462: 						      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
463: 						     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
464: 				chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
465: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
466: 			}
467: 			else
468: 			{
469: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 1;
470: 			}
471: 		}
472: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
473: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
474: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;
475: 		if (chnl_cb->probe_count < MB_UART_PROBE_MAX)
476: 		{
477: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
478: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() + MB_UART_PROBE_RETRY_MS;
479: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
480: 		}
481: 		else
482: 		{
483: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
484: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
485: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() +
486: 				MB_UART_DOWN_RETRY_MS;
487: 		}
488: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
489: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
490: 			chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
491: 		return;
492: 	}
493: 
494: 	/* try next Tx. */
495: 
496: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
497: 
498: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
499: 	{
500: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
501: 		if (ret_val == BK_OK)
502: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
503: 	}
504: 	if (ret_val != BK_OK)
505: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
506: 
507: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
508: 	{
509: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
510: 	}
511: 
512: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
513: 	{
514: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
515: 	}
516: 
517: 	return;
518: }

520: static void mb_uart_channel_event(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_event_t event)
521: {
522: 	if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT)
523: 	{
524: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
525: 	}
526: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_SENT)
527: 	{
528: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
529: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
530: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
531: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
532: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
533: 	}
534: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_FAILED)
535: 	{
536: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
537: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
538: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
539: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
540: 	}
541: 	else
542: 	{
543: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len)
544: 		{
545: 			/* Delivery is unknowable after a lost ACK. Drop this chunk instead
546: 			 * of replaying terminal input and making duplicate commands. */
547: 			chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
548: 					      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
549: 					     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
550: 			chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
551: 			chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
552: 			chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
553: 		}
554: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
555: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
556: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
557: 		chnl_cb->link_state = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT ?
558: 			MB_UART_LINK_ABORTING : MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
559: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET;
560: 		if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET)
561: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
562: 		else
563: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_TIMEOUT);
564: 	}
565: 
566: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
567: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
568: }

570: static bk_err_t mb_uart_init(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
571: {
572: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
573: 
574: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
575: 		return BK_OK;
576: 
577: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(mb_uart_cb_t));
578: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
579: 	chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
580: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
581: 
582: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
583: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
584: 
585: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) ||
586: 		(chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
587: 	{
588: 		return BK_FAIL;
589: 	}
590: 
591: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
592: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
593: 	{
594: 		return ret_code;
595: 	}
596: 
597: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_rx_isr);
598: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr);
599: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR, NULL);
600: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_channel_event);
601: 
602: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
603: 
604: 	return BK_OK;
605: }

627: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
628: {
629: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
630: 
631: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
632: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
633: 
634: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
635: 	{
636: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
637: 	}
638: 
639: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
640: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
641: 
642: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
643: 	{
644: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
645: 	}
646: 	else
647: 	{
648: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
649: 	}
650: 
651: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
652: 	{
653: 		return BK_FAIL;
654: 	}
655: 
656: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
657: 	{
658: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
659: 	}
660: 
661: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
662: 	{
663: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
664: 	}
665: 	else
666: 	{
667: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
668: 
669: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
670: 		{
671: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
672: 		}
673: 		else
674: 		{
675: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
676: 
677: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
678: 		}
679: 	}
680: 
681: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
682: 
683: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
684: 
685: 	memset(&uart_cmd, 0, sizeof(uart_cmd));
686: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
687: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
688: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
689: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
690: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
691: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);
692: 
693: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
694: 
695: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
696: 	{
697: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = cpy_len;
698: 	}
699: 
700: 	return ret_val;
701: }

703: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
704: {
705: 	u32 flag = mb_uart_enter_critical();
706: 
707: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_in_process != 0)
708: 	{
709: 		mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
710: 		return BK_OK;
711: 	}
712: 
713: 	chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 1;
714: 
715: 	mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
716: 
717: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
718: 
719: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
720: 
721: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
722: 	{
723: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
724: 	}
725: 
726: 	return ret_val;
727: }

729: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_state(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
730: {
731: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
732: 
733: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_STATE;
734: 
735: 	memset(&uart_cmd, 0, sizeof(uart_cmd));
736: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_STATE;
737: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = NULL;
738: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = 0;
739: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
740: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
741: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = 0;
742: 
743: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
744: 
745: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
746: 
747: 	return ret_val;
748: }

750: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_state_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
751: {
752: 	u32 flag = mb_uart_enter_critical();
753: 
754: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_in_process != 0)
755: 	{
756: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
757: 		mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
758: 		return BK_OK;
759: 	}
760: 
761: 	chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 1;
762: 
763: 	mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
764: 
765: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
766: 
767: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
768: 
769: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
770: 	{
771: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
772: 	}
773: 
774: 	return ret_val;
775: }

777: static u16 mb_uart_write_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 data_len)
778: {
779: 	u16    rem_len, wr_len;
780: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
781: 	
782: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
783: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
784: 
785: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
786: 	{
787: 		rem_len = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
788: 	}
789: 	else
790: 	{
791: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
792: 	}
793: 
794: 	wr_len = data_len;
795: 	if(wr_len > rem_len)
796: 		wr_len = rem_len;
797: 
798: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
799: 	{
800: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
801: 	}
802: 	else
803: 	{
804: 		if(rd_idx != 0)
805: 			rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - wr_idx;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
806: 
807: 		if(rem_len >= wr_len)
808: 		{
809: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
810: 		}
811: 		else
812: 		{
813: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, rem_len);
814: 
815: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf, data_buf + rem_len, wr_len - rem_len);
816: 		}
817: 	}
818: 
819: 	chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx = (wr_idx + wr_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
820: 
821: 	/* trigger send! */
822: 	mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
823: 
824: 	return wr_len;
825: }

827: static u16 mb_uart_read_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 buf_len)
828: {
829: 	u16    rem_len, rd_len;
830: 
831: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
832: 		return 0;
833: 
834: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, data_cnt;
835: 
836: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
837: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
838: 
839: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
840: 	{
841: 		data_cnt = wr_idx - rd_idx;
842: 	}
843: 	else
844: 	{
845: 		data_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
846: 	}
847: 
848: 	rd_len = data_cnt;
849: 	if(rd_len > buf_len)
850: 		rd_len = buf_len;
851: 
852: 	if(rd_len == 0)
853: 	{
854: 		return 0;
855: 	}
856: 
857: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
858: 	{
859: 		memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
860: 		chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
861: 	}
862: 	else
863: 	{
864: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - rd_idx;
865: 
866: 		if(rem_len > rd_len)
867: 		{
868: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
869: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
870: 		}
871: 		else
872: 		{
873: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
874: 			if(rem_len < rd_len)
875: 			{
876: 				memcpy(data_buf + rem_len, chnl_cb->rx_buf, rd_len - rem_len);
877: 			}
878: 
879: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx = rd_len - rem_len;
880: 		}
881: 	}
882: 
883: 	data_cnt -= rd_len;
884: 
885: 	/* rts assert...... */
886: 	if(data_cnt < ((sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - 1 - MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN) * 8 / 10))
887: 	{
888: 		if( chnl_cb->ctrl_rts != 0)
889: 		{
890: 			chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 0;
891: 			mb_uart_send_state_trigger(chnl_cb);
892: 		}
893: 	}
894: 
895: 	return rd_len;
896: 
897: }

378: u16 ap_console_bridge_write(const u8 *data, u16 length)
379: {
380: 	u16 written = 0;
381: 
382: 	if (!data || !length || !s_ap_bridge.link_ready)
383: 		return 0;
384: 
385: 	rtos_lock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
386: 	while (written < length)
387: 	{
388: 		u16 next = (s_ap_bridge.tx_wr + 1) % sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring);
389: 		if (next == s_ap_bridge.tx_rd)
390: 			break;
391: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_ring[s_ap_bridge.tx_wr] = data[written++];
392: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_wr = next;
393: 	}
394: 	rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
395: 	if (written < length)
396: 	{
397: 		s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_drop += length - written;
398: 	}
399: 	if (written)
400: 		ap_bridge_wake(AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TX);
401: 	return written;
402: }

525: static u8 * alloc_log_blk(u16 log_len, u16 *blk_tag)
526: {
527: 	u16    free_blk_id;
528: 	u8     queue_id;
529: 	u8     ovf_cnt_saved = 0;
530: 	free_queue_t * free_q;
531: 	u8     *       blk_buf = NULL;
532: 
533: 	u32  int_mask = shell_task_enter_critical();
534: 
535: 	for(queue_id = 0; queue_id < TBL_SIZE(free_queue); queue_id++)
536: 	{
537: 		free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
538: 
539: 		/*    queue ascending in blk_len.    */
540: 		if(free_q->blk_len < log_len)
541: 			continue;
542: 
543: 		if(free_q->free_blk_num > 0)
544: 		{
545: 			free_blk_id = free_q->blk_list[free_q->list_out_idx];
546: 
547: 			// free_q->list_out_idx = (free_q->list_out_idx + 1) % free_q->blk_num;
548: 			if((free_q->list_out_idx + 1) < free_q->blk_num)
549: 				free_q->list_out_idx++;
550: 			else
551: 				free_q->list_out_idx = 0;
552: 
553: 			free_q->free_blk_num--;
554: 
555: 			blk_buf = &free_q->log_buf[free_blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
556: 			*blk_tag = MAKE_BLOCK_TAG(free_blk_id, queue_id);
557: 
558: 			break;
559: 		}
560: 		else
561: 		{
562: 			if(ovf_cnt_saved == 0)
563: 			{
564: 				free_q->ovf_cnt++;
565: 				ovf_cnt_saved = 1;
566: 			}
567: 		}
568: 	}
569: 
570: 	if(blk_buf == NULL)
571: 	{
572: 		shell_log_overflow++;
573: 	}
574: 	else
575: 	{
576: 		fault_hint_print = 0;
577: 		shell_log_count++;
578: 	}
579: 
580: 	shell_task_exit_critical(int_mask);
581: 
582: 	return blk_buf;
583: }

616: static int merge_log_data(u16 blk_tag, u16 data_len)
617: {
618: 	if(pending_queue.list_out_idx == pending_queue.list_in_idx)  /* queue empty! */
619: 	{
620: 		return 0;
621: 	}
622: 
623: 	u8      queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(blk_tag);
624: 	u16     blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(blk_tag);
625: 	if(queue_id >= TBL_SIZE(free_queue))  /* not log buffer */
626: 	{
627: 		return 0;
628: 	}
629: 
630: 	free_queue_t *free_q;
631: 	free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
632: 
633: 	u8		* src_buf = NULL;
634: 
635: 	if(blk_id < free_q->blk_num)
636: 	{
637: 		src_buf = &free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
638: 	}
639: 	else
640: 		return 0;
641: 
642: 	u16    pre_in_idx;
643: 
644: 	if(pending_queue.list_in_idx > 0)
645: 		pre_in_idx = pending_queue.list_in_idx - 1;
646: 	else
647: 		pre_in_idx = SHELL_LOG_PEND_NUM - 1;
648: 
649: 	queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].blk_tag);
650: 	blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].blk_tag);
651: 	if(queue_id >= TBL_SIZE(free_queue))  /* not log buffer */
652: 	{
653: 		return 0;
654: 	}
655: 
656: 	u8		* dst_buf = NULL;
657: 	u16       buf_len = 0;
658: 
659: 	free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
660: 
661: 	if(blk_id < free_q->blk_num)
662: 	{
663: 		dst_buf = &free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
664: 		buf_len = free_q->blk_len;
665: 	}
666: 	else
667: 		return 0;
668: 
669: 	u16       cur_len = pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].packet_len;
670: 
671: 	if((cur_len + data_len) > buf_len)  /* can be merged into one buffer? */
672: 		return 0;
673: 
674: 	memcpy(dst_buf + cur_len, src_buf, data_len);
675: 
676: 	pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].packet_len += data_len;
677: 
678: 	free_log_blk(blk_tag);  /* merged, free the log buffer. */
679: 
680: 	return 1;
681: }

722: /* call from cmd TX ISR. */
723: static int cmd_tx_complete(u8 *pbuf, u16 buf_tag)
724: {
725: 	u8      queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(buf_tag);
726: 	u16     blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(buf_tag);
727: 
728: 	/* rsp ok ?? */
729: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_RSP_QUEUE_ID )    /* rsp. */
730: 	{
731: 		/* it is called from cmd_dev tx ISR. */
732: 
733: 		if ( (pbuf != cmd_line_buf.rsp_buff) || (blk_id != 0) )
734: 		{
735: 			/* something wrong!!! */
736: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FAULT: in rsp.\r\n");
737: 		}
738: 
739: 		/* rsp compelete, rsp_buff can be used for next cmd/response. */
740: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&cmd_line_buf.rsp_buf_semaphore);
741: 
742: #if CONFIG_MAILBOX
743: 		if (s_ap_open_request)
744: 			set_shell_event(&shell_task_event, SHELL_EVENT_AP_SWITCH);
745: #endif
746: 
747: 		return 1;
748: 	}
749: 
750: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_IND_QUEUE_ID )    /* cmd_ind. */
751: 	{
752: 		/* it is called from cmd_dev tx ISR. */
753: 
754: 		if ( (pbuf != cmd_line_buf.cmd_ind_buff) || (blk_id != 0) )
755: 		{
756: 			/* something wrong!!! */
757: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FAULT: indication.\r\n");
758: 		}
759: 
760: 		/* indication tx compelete, cmd_ind_buff can be used for next cmd_indication. */
761: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&cmd_line_buf.ind_buf_semaphore);
762: 
763: 		return 1;
764: 	}
765: 
766: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_ROM_QUEUE_ID )    /* fault hints buffer, point to flash. */
767: 	{
768: 		/* it is called from cmd_dev tx ISR. */
769: 
770: 		if (blk_id == 1)
771: 		{
772: 			if(pbuf != (u8 *)shell_cmd_ovf_str)
773: 			{
774: 				/* something wrong!!! */
775: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FATAL:t-%x,p-%x\r\n", buf_tag, pbuf);
776: 			}
777: 
778: 			cmd_line_buf.cmd_ovf_hint = 0;
779: 
780: 			return 1;
781: 		}
782: 	}
783: 
784: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_FWD_QUEUE_ID )    /* slave buffer. */
785: 	{
786: 		#if defined(FWD_CMD_TO_MBOX)
787: 		if (log_handle_init_ok) {
788: 			set_fwd_state(blk_id);
789: 		} else {
790: 			result_fwd(blk_id);
791: 		}
792: 		return 1;
793: 		#endif
794: 	}
795: 
796: 	return 0;
797: }

114: static int ipc_heartbeat_timeout(void)
115: {
116: 	u32   cur_time;
117: 
118: 	cur_time = (u32)rtos_get_time();
119: 
120: 	if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
121: 	{
122: 		return 0;
123: 	}
124: 	if((cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING) || (cpu_x_dump != 0))
125: 	{
126: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = cur_time;
127: 		return 0;
128: 	}
129: 
130: 	if(cur_time >= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)
131: 	{
132: 		cur_time -= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp;
133: 	}
134: 	else
135: 	{
136: 		cur_time += (~(cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)) + 1;  // wrap around.
137: 	}
138: 
139: 	if(cur_time < HB_TIMEOUT_MS)
140: 	{
141: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
142: 		return 0;
143: 	}
144: 
145: 	if (bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_get(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT))
146: 	{
147: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
148: 		bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_clear(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT);
149: 		return 0;
150: 	}
151: 
152: 	if(s_mb_ipc_work_state == MB_IPC_EXIT_LV)
153: 	{
154: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
155: 		s_mb_ipc_work_state = MB_IPC_WORKING;
156: 		return 0;
157: 	}
158: 
159: 	return 1;
160: }

220: static void mb_ipc_task( void *para )
221: {
222: 	bk_err_t	ret_val;
223: 	u32    events;
224: 	u32    check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
225: 
226: 	mb_ipc_init_lv_callback();
227: 
228: 	ret_val = rtos_init_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event);
229: 
230: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
231: 	{
232: 		rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
233: 		return;
234: 	}
235: 
236: 	while(1)
237: 	{
238: 		events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_ALL_FLAGS, true, check_time);
239: 
240: 		if(events == 0)
241: 		{
242: 			// timeout, so check heartbeat.
243: 			events = MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG;
244: 		}
245: 
246: 		if(events & MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG)  // process this event at first!!!!
247: 		{
248: 			if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
249: 			{
250: 				events = 0;  // clear all events.
251: 			}
252: 		}
253: 		
254: 		if(events & MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG)
255: 		{
256: 			u8   retry_cnt = 0;
257: 
258: 			while(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
259: 			{
260: 				ipc_heartbeat_timeout();
261: 				
262: 				if(events & MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG)
263: 				{
264: 					if(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
265: 					{
266: 						cpu_x_state = CORE_POWER_ON;
267: 						break;  // cpu1 power on. 
268: 					}
269: 				}
270: 				else
271: 				{
272: 					if( retry_cnt > 3)
273: 					{
274: 						BK_DUMP_OUT("IPC retry to start core%d, retry_cnt:%d\r\n", cpu_x_id, retry_cnt);
275: 						// restart_cpu_x();
276: 						break;
277: 					}
278: 					else
279: 					{
280: 						events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG, true, 2000);//2s
281: 					}
282: 				}
283: 
284: 				retry_cnt++;
285: 			}
286: 
287: 			// discard this event when not in CORE_STARTING state.
288: 		}
289: 		
290: 		if(events & MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
291: 		{
292: 			if(ipc_heartbeat_timeout())
293: 			{
294: 				BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC[%d]heartbeat timeout %d,%d\r\n",cpu_x_id,cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp,(u32)rtos_get_time());
295: 				/*when cpu1 heartbeat timeout, then system reboot*/
296: 				cpu_x_heartbeat_timeout = 1;
297: 				ap_console_bridge_link_down();
298: 				BK_ASSERT(false);
299: 			}
300: 		}
301: 
302: 		if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
303: 		{
304: 			check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
305: 		}
306: 		else
307: 		{
308: 			check_time = HB_TIMEOUT_MS;
309: 		}
310: 	}
311: }

45:   while (total < length)

47:       size_t chunk = length - total;
48:       ssize_t ret;

59:         }

65:         }

1: #!/bin/sh
2: 
3: set -eu
4: 
5: script_dir=$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")
6: csv=${1:-$script_dir/../../../../external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv}
7: generated=${2:-${BK7258_ARMINO_RAM_HEADER:-}}
8: header=$script_dir/hardware/bk7258_mbox.h
9: linker=$script_dir/../../boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/scripts/ld.script
10: 
11: if [ ! -r "$csv" ]; then
12:   printf '%s\n' "BK7258 SWAP layout: cannot read $csv" >&2
13:   exit 1
14: fi
15: 
16: result=$(awk -F, '
17:   function hex(value, result, i, digit) {
18:     sub(/^0[xX]/, "", value)
19:     value = tolower(value)
20:     result = 0
21:     for (i = 1; i <= length(value); i++) {
22:       digit = index("0123456789abcdef", substr(value, i, 1)) - 1
23:       if (digit < 0) return -1
24:       result = result * 16 + digit
25:     }
26:     return result
27:   }
28:   BEGIN { base = hex("28000000"); found = 0 }
29:   /^[[:space:]]*#/ { next }
30:   /^[[:space:]]*PSRAM_CAPCAITY_SIZE/ { next }
31:   NF >= 4 {
32:     name = $1
33:     type = $2
34:     offset = $3
35:     size = $4
36:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", name)
37:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", type)
38:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", offset)
39:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", size)
40:     if (type != "SRAM") next
41:     if (offset != "") base = hex(offset)
42:     bytes = hex(size)
43:     if (name == "SWAP") {
44:       printf "0x%08x 0x%08x\n", base, bytes
45:       found = 1
46:     }
47:     base += bytes
48:   }
49:   END { if (!found) exit 2 }
50: ' "$csv")
51: 
52: if [ "$result" != "0x2809f800 0x00000800" ]; then
53:   printf '%s\n' "BK7258 SWAP layout mismatch: $result" >&2
54:   exit 1
55: fi
56: 
57: header_result=$(awk '
58:   /#define[[:space:]]+BK7258_SWAP_BASE/ { gsub(/[uUlL]/, "", $3); base=tolower($3) }
59:   /#define[[:space:]]+BK7258_SWAP_SIZE/ { gsub(/[uUlL]/, "", $3); size=tolower($3) }
60:   END { print base, size }
61: ' "$header")
62: 
63: if [ "$header_result" != "0x2809f800 0x00000800" ]; then
64:   printf '%s\n' "BK7258 header SWAP mismatch: $header_result" >&2
65:   exit 1
66: fi
67: 
68: linker_result=$(awk '
69:   /SWAP[[:space:]]+\(rw\)/ {
70:     for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) {
71:       if ($i == "ORIGIN") base=$(i + 2)
72:       if ($i == "LENGTH") size=$(i + 2)
73:     }
74:     gsub(/,/, "", base)
75:     print tolower(base), tolower(size)
76:   }
77: ' "$linker")
78: 
79: if [ "$linker_result" != "0x2809f800 0x00000800" ]; then
80:   printf '%s\n' "BK7258 linker SWAP mismatch: $linker_result" >&2
81:   exit 1
82: fi
83: 
84: if [ -n "$generated" ]; then
85:   if [ ! -r "$generated" ]; then
86:     printf '%s\n' "BK7258 generated RAM header unreadable: $generated" >&2
87:     exit 1
88:   fi
89: 
90:   generated_result=$(awk '
91:     /#define[[:space:]]+CONFIG_SWAP_ADDR/ { gsub(/[uUlL]/, "", $3); base=tolower($3) }
92:     /#define[[:space:]]+CONFIG_SWAP_SIZE/ { gsub(/[uUlL]/, "", $3); size=tolower($3) }
93:     END { print base, size }
94:   ' "$generated")
95:   if [ "$generated_result" != "0x2809f800 0x00000800" ]; then
96:     printf '%s\n' "BK7258 generated RAM header mismatch: $generated_result" >&2
97:     exit 1
98:   fi
99: fi

139: 	u8 data[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];

142: 	u16 written;
143: 	u16 i;
144: 	u32 flags;

147: 	{

149: 		length = MIN(length, bk_mb_uart_write_ready(MB_UART0));
150: 		if (!length)

153: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
154: 		for (i = 0; i < length; i++)

156: 							 sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring)];
157: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
158: 
159: 		written = bk_mb_uart_write(MB_UART0, data, length);
160: 		if (!written)
161: 			break;
162: 		if (written < length)
163: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_partial++;
164: 
165: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
166: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_rd = (s_ap_bridge.tx_rd + written) %
167: 					 sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring);
168: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
169: 		s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_bytes += written;
170: 	}

173: static void ap_bridge_task(beken_thread_arg_t arg)
174: {
175: 	u8 input[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];
176: 	u8 line[AP_BRIDGE_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
177: 	u16 line_length = 0;
178: 	u8 active_mode = AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_LOG;
179: 
180: 	(void)arg;
181: 	for (;;)
182: 	{
183: 		u32 events;
184: 		u32 flags;
185: 		u16 input_length;
186: 		u16 index;
187: 		bk_err_t ret = rtos_get_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem,
188: 			line_length ? AP_BRIDGE_LOG_FLUSH_MS : 20);
189: 
190: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
191: 		events = s_ap_bridge.events;
192: 		s_ap_bridge.events = 0;
193: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
194: 
195: 		bk_mb_uart_poll(MB_UART0);
196: 		if ((events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_READY) ||
197: 			bk_mb_uart_is_link_ready(MB_UART0))
198: 			s_ap_bridge.link_ready = 1;
199: 		if (events & (AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET |
200: 			      AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT))
201: 			s_ap_bridge.link_ready = 0;
202: 
203: 		if (active_mode != s_ap_bridge.output_mode)
204: 		{
205: 			if (line_length)
206: 				ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length);
207: 			line_length = 0;
208: 			active_mode = s_ap_bridge.output_mode;
209: 			BK_LOGI(AP_BRIDGE_TAG, "output mode=%s\r\n",
210: 				active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_RAW ? "RAW" : "LOG");
211: 		}
212: 
213: 		do
214: 		{
215: 			input_length = bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, input, sizeof(input));
216: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_bytes += input_length;
217: 			if (active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_RAW)
218: 			{
219: 				if (input_length && !shell_log_raw_data(input, input_length))
220: 					s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_queue_fail++;
221: 				continue;
222: 			}
223: 
224: 			for (index = 0; index < input_length; index++)
225: 			{
226: 				line[line_length++] = input[index];
227: 				if (input[index] == '\n' || line_length == sizeof(line))
228: 				{
229: 					ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length);
230: 					line_length = 0;
231: 				}
232: 			}
233: 		} while (input_length != 0);
234: 
235: 		if (ret == kTimeoutErr && line_length &&
236: 			active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_LOG)
237: 		{
238: 			ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length);
239: 			line_length = 0;
240: 		}
241: 
242: 		ap_bridge_drain_tx();
243: 
244: 		if (events & (AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET |
245: 			      AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT))
246: 		{
247: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.link_down++;
248: 			if (events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET)
249: 				s_ap_bridge.stats.reset++;
250: 			if (events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT)
251: 				s_ap_bridge.stats.timeout++;
252: 			BK_LOGW(AP_BRIDGE_TAG, "link down event=%x queued=%u\r\n",
253: 				events, ap_bridge_tx_count());
254: 			shell_ap_console_link_down();
255: 		}
256: 	}

304: u16 ap_console_bridge_write(const u8 *data, u16 length)
305: {
306: 	u16 written = 0;
307: 	u32 flags;
308: 
309: 	if (!data || !length || !s_ap_bridge.link_ready)
310: 		return 0;
311: 
312: 	flags = rtos_disable_int();
313: 	while (written < length)
314: 	{
315: 		u16 next = (s_ap_bridge.tx_wr + 1) % sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring);
316: 		if (next == s_ap_bridge.tx_rd)
317: 			break;
318: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_ring[s_ap_bridge.tx_wr] = data[written++];
319: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_wr = next;
320: 	}
321: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
322: 	if (written < length)
323: 	{
324: 		s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_drop += length - written;
325: 		if (s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_drop == (u32)(length - written) ||
326: 			!(s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_drop & 0xff))
327: 			BK_LOGW(AP_BRIDGE_TAG, "TX overflow drop=%u total=%u\r\n",
328: 				length - written, (unsigned)s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_drop);
329: 	}
330: 	if (written)
331: 		ap_bridge_wake(AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TX);
332: 	return written;
